children.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, 1
Henceforth [follow] the supplements (<s>pariśiṣṭa</s>) of the <s>Maitrāyaṇīya Sūtra</s>.

children.text: gṛhyapuruṣaḥ prāyaścittam anugrahikahautṛkaśulvikottareṣṭakavaiṣṇavādhvaryavikacāturhotṛkagonāmikākulapādarahasyapratigrahayamakavṛṣotsargapraśnadraviṇaṣaṭkāraṇapradhānasāṃdehikapravarādhyāyarudravidhānachando'nukramaṇyantarkyakalpapravāsavidhiprātarupasthānabhūtotpattir iti dvāviṃśatiḥ pariśiṣṭasaṃkhyānām // VGrs_1.1
children.translated_text: The domestic person (<s>gṛhyapuruṣa</s>), expiations (<s>prāyaścitta</s>), the favorable rites (<s>anugrahika</s>), the <s>Hautṛka</s>, the <s>Śulvika</s>, the <s>Uttareṣṭaka</s>, the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, the <s>Ādhvaryavika</s>, the <s>Cāturhotṛka</s>, the <s>Gonāmikā</s>, the <s>Kulapāda</s>, the secret teachings (<s>rahasya</s>), the accepting of gifts (<s>pratigraha</s>), the twin rites (<s>yamaka</s>), the releasing of the bull (<s>vṛṣotsarga</s>), the questions (<s>praśna</s>), the gifts (<s>draviṇa</s>), the six causes (<s>ṣaṭkāraṇa</s>), the principal (<s>pradhāna</s>), the doubtful cases (<s>sāṃdehika</s>), the lineages (<s>pravara</s>), the studies (<s>adhyāya</s>), the <s>Rudra</s> rite (<s>rudravidhāna</s>), the meters (<s>chandas</s>), the index (<s>anukramaṇī</s>), the internal ritual (<s>antarkya</s>), the <s>kalpa</s> (ritual manual), the rites for travel (<s>pravāsavidhi</s>), the morning worship (<s>prātarupasthāna</s>), and the origin of beings (<s>bhūtotpatti</s>) — these are the twenty-two in the enumeration of supplements.

body.translated_text: One should perform the <s>pākayajñas</s> (cooked oblations) in the domestic fire (<s>gṛhyāgni</s>).

children.translated_text: It is called <s>pākayajña</s> because of its brevity.
For that which is brief is called '<s>pāka</s>' (cooking/simple).

body.translated_text: The <s>pākayajña</s> rite follows the model of the <s>Darśapūrṇamāsa</s> (new and full moon sacrifices), [but it is] without the <s>prayāja</s> (fore-offerings), without the <s>anuyāja</s> (after-offerings), and without the <s>sāmidhenī</s> verses.
The oblations are [made] after reciting [the formula] ending with '<s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: paratantrotpattir dakṣiṇāgnāv āhitāgniḥ kurvīta śālāgnāv anāhitāgniḥ // VGrs_1.6
body.translated_text: Originating from the other ritual system (<s>paratantra</s>), one who has established the [three] fires should perform [the rite] in the <s>dakṣiṇāgni</s> (southern fire); one who has not established the [three] fires should do so in the <s>śālāgni</s> (house fire).

body.text:
gomayena gocarmamātraṃ caturasraṃ sthaṇḍilam upalipyeṣumātraṃ tasmin lakṣaṇaṃ kurvīta satyasadasīti paścārdhād udīcīṃ lekhāṃ likhati /
ṛtasadasīti dakṣiṇārdhāt prācīm /
gharmasadasīty uttarārdhāt prācīm /
madhye dve tisro vā prācīḥ /

children.translated_text: with '<s>ūrjasvatī</s>' (you are full of vigor) a southward [line];
with '<s>payasvatī</s>' (you are full of milk) a northward [line];
with '<s>Indrāya tva</s>' (for you, <s>Indra</s>) [a line] from the middle, optionally;
all [lines] should be the span of a hand, scratched with a <s>darbha</s> grass blade.
Having sprinkled with water, one establishes the fire.

children.text: parisamuhya paristīrya paryukṣya tūṣṇīm idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahya grāgagrair dakṣiṇārambhair udaksaṃsthairayugmair dhātubhiḥ stṛṇāti // VGrs_1.9
children.translated_text: Having swept, having strewn [<s>darbha</s> grass] around, having sprinkled around, silently having tied up the fuel-wood and the sacrificial grass (<s>barhis</s>), one strews with an odd number of stalks, [placed] with tips facing forward, beginning from the south, with ends pointing north.
Having seated the <s>Brahman</s> priest to the south of the fire, [one places] the water vessel to the north.
One makes the purifying blades (<s>pavitre</s>) from the sacrificial grass (<s>barhis</s>).

children.text: samāv apracchinnaprāntau darbhau prādeśamātrau pavitre stho vaiṣṇavye ityoṣadhyā chittvā viṣṇormanasā pūte stha ity adbhis trir unmṛjya prokṣaṇīr dharmaiḥ saṃskṛtya praṇītāṃ praṇīya nirvapaṇaprokṣaṇasaṃvapanam iti yathādevataṃ carum adhiśritya sruksruvaṃ pramṛjyābhyukṣyāgnau pratāpyāditir asi nācchinnapattrety ājyam agnāv adhiśrayati // VGrs_1.12
children.translated_text: Two even, uncut-tipped <s>darbha</s> grasses, a span long — [saying] 'You are purifiers, belonging to <s>Viṣṇu</s>' — having cut [them] with a plant, [saying] 'You are purified by the mind of <s>Viṣṇu</s>' — having wiped thrice with water, preparing the sprinkling waters through the consecrating rites, having brought forward the <s>praṇītā</s> water, having placed on the fire the <s>caru</s> (oblation porridge) according to the deity together with the pouring, sprinkling, and strewing — having wiped the offering ladle (<s>sruk</s>) and the pouring ladle (<s>sruva</s>), having sprinkled them, having heated them in the fire — [saying] 'You are <s>Aditi</s>, [the cutting blade] of uncut leaf' — one places the ghee (<s>ājya</s>) on the fire.
With 'You are the milk of <s>Pṛśni</s>' one pours out the ghee.

children.text: pari vājapatir ityājyahaviś ca triḥ paryagnikaroti // VGrs_1.14
children.translated_text: With '<s>pari vājapatir</s>' one carries the ghee oblation (<s>ājyahavis</s>) around the fire three times.

children.text: devas tvā savitotpunātv ityājyaṃ śrapayati // VGrs_1.15
children.translated_text: With '<s>devas tvā Savitar utpunātu</s>' (may the god <s>Savitṛ</s> purify you) one cooks the ghee.

children.text: tūṣṇīm idhmābarhir viprokṣya yathā mnātam abhiparistṛṇāti // VGrs_1.16
children.translated_text: Having silently sprinkled the fuel-wood and the sacrificial grass, one strews around as prescribed.
One lays down the enclosing sticks (<s>paridhis</s>).
With '<s>tejo 'si</s>' (you are splendor) having inspected the ghee, one places [it] behind the fire on the <s>darbha</s> grasses.
Having anointed [it], one removes the boiled rice oblation (<s>sthālīpāka</s>) to the north.
Having placed the fuel-wood just once, the offering to <s>Vairūpākṣa</s> is the first of the oblations.

children.text: brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā yunajmi tveti ca yojayitvā // VGrs_1.21
children.translated_text: Having addressed the <s>Brahman</s> priest, having placed a piece of fuel-wood, having performed the two <s>āghāra</s> oblations, having offered the two <s>ājyabhāga</s> portions, and having yoked [the fire] with '<s>yunajmi tvā</s>' (I yoke you),

children.text: nahy ayukto havyaṃ vahata iti ha vijñāyate // VGrs_1.22
children.translated_text: for it is known [by tradition] that an unyoked [fire] does not carry the oblation.
Optionally, one may offer the yoking [oblation] before the <s>dhur</s> [oblation]:

children.text: yukto vaha jātavedaḥ purastādidaṃ viddhi kriyamāṇaṃ yatheha /
children.translated_text: 'Carry, O yoked <s>Jātavedas</s>, know beforehand this [ritual] being performed here.',

children.text: tvaṃ bhiṣagbheṣajasyāsi goptā tvayā prasūtā gāmaśvaṃ pūruṣaṃ sanema /
children.translated_text: 'You are the physician and the guardian of medicine; by you may we obtain cattle, horses, and men,
<s>svāhā</s>.'
Thus.

children.text: viśvā agne tvayā vayaṃ dhārā udanyā iva /
children.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, through you may we [cross over] all streams like waters seeking [a passage];
may we ford across enmity.'
Thus.
Having sacrificed to the lunar mansion (<s>nakṣatra</s>), one should worship the deity;
and the day-and-night, the season, and the lunar day (<s>tithi</s>).

children.text: abhighārya yaddevataṃ haviḥ syāttac ca juhuyād yathādevataṃ yathādevatayā carcā // VGrs_1.26
children.translated_text: Having anointed [the oblation], whatever oblation belongs to whichever deity, one should offer that, and the verse for each deity according to its deity.
'To <s>ākūta</s> (intention), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>ākūti</s> (intention), <s>svāhā</s>!' — thus one should offer the <s>jaya</s> (victory) oblations.
'<s>Prajāpati</s> bestowed.'

children.text: iḍām agna iti sviṣṭakṛtam uttarārdhapūrvārdhe juhuyāt // VGrs_1.28
children.translated_text: '<s>Iḍā</s>, O <s>Agni</s>' — one should offer the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> (oblation to the fire that has made the offering successful) in the northeast portion of the western half.
One should place alongside the stirring stick (<s>mekṣaṇa</s>), the under-holder (<s>upayāma</s>), and the purifying blades.
'<s>Anumati</s>, may you [be favorable] to us today.'
'<s>Anumati</s>, be favorable to you.' — Thus.
And the expiatory oblations with '<s>bhūḥ svāhā</s>' (earth, <s>svāhā</s>).
'You, O <s>Agni</s>, for us...'
'That you, O <s>Agni</s>, for us...'
'Mind is light...'
'Thirty-three are the threads (<s>tantavas</s>)...'
And '<s>ayāś cāgne 'si</s>' (and you are imperishable, O <s>Agni</s>).

children.text: imaṃ stanaṃ madhumantaṃ dhayāpāṃ prapīnamagne salilasya madhye /
children.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, suck this breast rich in honey, the swelling [breast] of the waters, in the midst of the flood;

children.text: utsaṃ juṣasva madhumantam ūrmiṃ samudryaṃ sadanam āviśasva /
children.translated_text: enjoy the honey-laden spring, the wave of the ocean; enter the abode,
<s>svāhā</s>.'
Thus one offers the oblation for the releasing of the enclosing sticks (<s>paridhivimoka</s>).
With '<s>annapate</s>' (O lord of food) one should offer [an oblation] of food.
'You are the kindling (<s>edhas</s>); may we kindle (<s>edhīṣīmahi</s>), <s>svāhā</s>' — thus one places a piece of fuel-wood;
'You are the fuel-stick (<s>samid</s>); may we prosper (<s>samedhiṣīmahi</s>)' — the second [piece].
One should carry out a full vessel on the sacrificial grass (<s>barhis</s>).
This is the concluding bath (<s>avabhṛtha</s>).
This is the procedure (<s>tantra</s>) for the <s>pākayajñas</s> (cooked oblations).
Having purified oneself with the '<s>āpo hi ṣṭhā</s>' [hymn], one should sprinkle around.
The choice gift (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>) is the best [available];
a horse should be known as the best;
a cow, according to some.

children.text: prāṅmukham udaṅmukhaṃ vā sūtikālayaṃ kalpayitvā dhruvaṃ prapadye śubhaṃ prapadya āśāṃ prapadya iti kāle prapādayet // VGrs_2.1
children.translated_text: Having prepared the birthing chamber (<s>sūtikālaya</s>) facing east or facing north, [the mother] should step forth at the [proper] time with [the formulas] 'I resort to steadfastness (<s>dhruva</s>),' 'I resort to auspiciousness (<s>śubha</s>),' 'I resort to hope (<s>āśā</s>).'

children.text: reto mūtramiti cyāvanībhyāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣim abhimṛśet /
children.translated_text: With the two <s>cyāvanī</s> verses [beginning with] 'The seed, the urine,' one should touch the right side [of the mother's womb];
or one should make [her] hear [the verses].

children.text: putraṃ jātam anvakṣaṃ snātaṃ na mātopahanyād ā mantraprayogāt // VGrs_2.3
children.translated_text: A son just born, bathed immediately, the mother should not strike until the application of the mantras.

children.text: agner abhyāhitasya parisamūḍhasya paristīrṇasya paścād ahate vāsasi kumāraṃ prākśirasam uttānaṃ saṃveśya palāśasya madhyamaṃ parṇaṃ praveṣṭya tenāsya karṇāv ājapet bhūs tvayi dadhānīti dakṣiṇe /
children.translated_text: Behind the fire that has been supplied [with fuel], swept around, and strewn around, having placed the infant on fresh garments with its head facing east and lying face-up, having inserted the middle leaf of a <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) tree, with that one should whisper into his ears: '<s>bhūḥ</s> (earth) I place in you' — into the right [ear];
'<s>bhuvaḥ</s> (atmosphere) I place in you' — into the left;
'<s>svaḥ</s> (heaven) I place in you' — into the right;

children.text: bhūr bhuvaḥ svas tvayi dadhānīti savye // VGrs_2.4
children.translated_text: '<s>bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ</s> (earth, atmosphere, heaven) I place in you' — into the left.
Then they address him:

children.text: aśmā bhava paraśur bhava hiraṇyam astṛtaṃ bhava /
children.translated_text: 'Be [hard as] stone, be [sharp as] an axe, be gold that cannot be cut;
from limb to limb you were born, from the heart you were produced;

children.text: ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam /
children.translated_text: the self indeed you are, named 'son'; live a hundred autumns.'
Thus.

children.text: yatra śete tadabhimṛśet veda te bhūmi hṛdayaṃ divi candramasi śritam /
children.translated_text: One should touch the [ground] where [the child] lies, [saying:] 'O Earth, I know your heart, established in the moon in heaven;

children.text: vedāmṛtasya devā māhaṃ putryam aghaṃ rudam /
children.translated_text: may I, knowing the immortal [secret] of the gods, not weep on account of [harm to] my son.'
Thus.

children.text: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā vyāhṛtibhiś catasra ājyāhutīr juhuyāt /
children.translated_text: Having prepared the ghee (<s>ājya</s>), having addressed the <s>Brahman</s> priest, having placed a piece of fuel-wood, having performed the two <s>āghāra</s> oblations, having offered the two <s>ājyabhāga</s> portions, one should offer four <s>ājya</s> oblations with the <s>vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred exclamations <s>bhūḥ</s>, <s>bhuvaḥ</s>, <s>svaḥ</s>);
some [add] the <s>jaya</s>, <s>abhyātāna</s>, and <s>rāṣṭrabhṛt</s> oblations.

children.text: kāṃsye camase vāhūtisampātān avanīya tasmin suvarṇaṃ saṃnighṛṣya vyāhṛtibhiḥ kumāraṃ catuḥ prāśayet /
children.translated_text: Having collected the remaining oblation-drops in a bronze or wooden cup, having rubbed gold therein with the <s>vyāhṛtis</s>, one should feed [the mixture] to the infant four times;

children.text: atyantam eke suvarṇaprāśanam udake nighṛṣyā dvādaśavarṣatāyāḥ // VGrs_2.8
children.translated_text: some [say] the gold-feeding should be done excessively, having rubbed [the gold] in water, until [the child's] twelfth year.
'Fill with nourishment (<s>iṣa</s>)!'
'Fill with vigor (<s>ūrja</s>)!' — having washed the breasts, one should give [the child] to suckle;
the right [breast] first, the left afterward.

children.text: sviṣṭakṛte hutvā prāyaścittāhutīśca samidhamādhāya paryukṣati // VGrs_2.10
children.translated_text: Having offered the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> oblation and the expiatory oblations and having placed fuel-wood, one sprinkles around.
This is the conclusion of the rite. The fire outside the door is permanent;
the oblation [consists] of rice grains, mustard seeds, and barley;
one should offer with the <s>vyāhṛtis</s>.
One should recite the <s>Apratiratham</s> [hymn];
and the six-verse [hymn beginning with] '<s>Indro bhūtasya</s>' (Indra of what has come to be).

children.text: sūtikālayaṃ yathākālaṃ samantād udakena pariṣiñcet // VGrs_2.13
children.translated_text: The birthing chamber should be sprinkled all around with water at the appropriate times.

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, 2

children.text: evam eva daśamyāṃ kṛtvā pitā mātā ca putrasya nāma dadhyatām ghoṣavadādyantarantasthaṃ dīrghābhiniṣṭānāntaṃ kṛtaṃ na taddhitaṃ dvyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā tyaktvā pitur nāmadheyāt nakṣatradevateṣṭanāmāno vā // VGrs_3.1
children.translated_text: Having done likewise on the tenth [day], the father and the mother should give the son a name: [it should be] resonant, with a semivowel at the beginning, end, or middle, ending with a long vowel or visarga, a formed [name] not a secondary derivative (<s>taddhita</s>), of two or four syllables — or [alternatively], abandoning the father's name, [named] after the <s>nakṣatra</s> (lunar mansion), the deity, or a desired name.
A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should have two names.

children.text: nāmaiva kanyāyāḥ akāravyavadhānam ākārāntam ayugmākṣaraṃ nadīnakṣatracandrasūryapūṣadevadattarakṣitāvarjam // VGrs_3.3
children.translated_text: For a girl, the very name [should be such that:] it is broken by the vowel 'a,' ending in the long vowel 'ā,' with an odd number of syllables, avoiding [names of] rivers, <s>nakṣatras</s>, <s>Candra</s> (moon), <s>Sūrya</s> (sun), <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Devadattā</s>, and <s>Rakṣitā</s>.

children.text: navanītena pāṇī pralipya somasya tvā dyumnenety enamabhimṛśet // VGrs_3.4
children.translated_text: Having smeared both palms with fresh butter, with '<s>somasya tvā dyumnena</s>' (by the brilliance of <s>Soma</s>) one should touch [the child].

children.text: sarveṣu kumārakarmasv āgneyaḥ sthālīpākaḥ prājāpatyo vā // VGrs_3.5
children.translated_text: In all rites for the child (<s>kumārakarma</s>), a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (boiled rice oblation) [offered] to <s>Agni</s> or to <s>Prajāpati</s> [should be prepared].
Everywhere where there is no [specific] injunction, <s>Agni</s> [is the deity] for males, <s>Aryaman</s> for females.

children.text: saṃvatsaraṃ mātāpitarau na māṃsam aśnīyātām // VGrs_3.7
children.translated_text: For a year, the mother and father should not eat meat.

children.text: putrasya jātadante yajetāgniṃ gavā paśunā vā // VGrs_3.8
children.translated_text: When the son's [first] tooth appears, one should sacrifice to <s>Agni</s> with a cow or with an animal.

children.text: viproṣitaḥ pratyetya putrasya mūrdhānaṃ trir ājighret paśūnāṃ tvā hiṃkāreṇābhijighrāmīti // VGrs_3.9
children.translated_text: Having returned from a journey, he should smell the head of his son three times [saying]: 'I smell you with the <s>hiṃkāra</s> (lowing) of cattle.'

children.text: jātakarmavaddhastāṅguliṃ praveṣṭya tenāsya karṇāv ājapet // VGrs_3.10
children.translated_text: As in the birth ceremony (<s>jātakarma</s>), having inserted the thumb of his hand [into the child's mouth], he should cause [the child] to lick both ears with it.
Then he addresses him [with the mantra]: 'Be a stone.'

children.text: agnidhanvantarī putravratī chāgameṣābhyām iṣṭvā dīrghāṇāṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ kumāraṃ catuḥ prāśayet /
children.translated_text: One who keeps the fire (<s>agnidhanvantarī</s>), observing the son-vow, having offered with a male goat and a ram, should feed the child four times with the extended <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances),
and [with the mantra]: 'O God, giver of life.'

children.text: kumārakarmāṇi śukla udagayane puṇye nakṣatre navamīvarjam /
children.translated_text: The childhood rites (<s>kumārakarma</s>) [should be performed] during the bright [fortnight], when the sun moves northward, on an auspicious <s>nakṣatra</s> (lunar mansion), avoiding the ninth [day].

children.text: sarva ṛtavo vivāhe 'māghacaitrau māsau parihāpyottaraṃ ca naidāgham // VGrs_3.13
children.translated_text: All seasons [are suitable] for marriage, except the months of <s>Māgha</s> and <s>Caitra</s>, and the later summer [heat].
After initiating [the ceremonies], the oblation [is performed].

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, 3

children.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, [Chapter] 4.
They make the matted locks (<s>jaṭā</s>) [i.e., perform the first tonsure] in the third year.
Or according to the family custom.

body.text: agnim upasamādhāya parisamuhya paristīrya paryukṣya dakṣiṇato 'gner brahmāṇam upaveśyottarata udapātraṃ śamīśamakavat // VGrs_4.2
body.translated_text: Having set up the fire, having swept [the ground], having spread [the grass], having sprinkled [water], he seats the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> to the south of the fire and [places] a water vessel to the north, containing <s>śamī</s> (acacia) wood.

body.text:
athainam abhimantrayate hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucaya iti catasṛbhiḥ /
yā oṣadhaya ityanuvākena /
śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye /
śaṃ yor abhisravantu naḥ /
priyāḥ śaṃ na āpo dhanvanyāḥ śaṃ naḥ santu nūpyāḥ /
śaṃ naḥ samudryā āpaḥ śam u naḥ santu kūpyāḥ /

children.text: śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatv aryamā /
children.translated_text: 'May <s>Mitra</s> be auspicious to us, may <s>Varuṇa</s> be auspicious, may <s>Aryaman</s> be auspicious to us;

children.text: śaṃ na indraś cāgniś ca śaṃ no viṣṇur urukramaḥ /
children.translated_text: may <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> be auspicious to us, may <s>Viṣṇu</s> of wide strides be auspicious to us.'
Thus.

children.text: tāsām udakārthān kurvīta paryukṣaṇe 'bhyundane snāpane ca // VGrs_4.3
children.translated_text: He should use those [waters] for the water-rites: for sprinkling, for pouring over, and for bathing.

children.text: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā agnā āyūṃṣi pavasa iti saptabhiḥ sapta hutvā // VGrs_4.4
children.translated_text: Having prepared the clarified butter (<s>ājya</s>), having addressed the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, having placed the fuel-stick, having poured the two <s>āghāra</s> oblations, having offered the two portions of <s>ājya</s>, he offers seven oblations with the seven [verses] '<s>Agna</s>, you purify the life-spans.'
And [with the mantra]: 'O God, giver of life.'

children.text: ye keśinaḥ prathame sattram āsata yebhir āvṛtaṃ yadidaṃ virājati /
children.translated_text: 'Those long-haired ones who first sat at the sacrificial session, by whom that which shines [the sun] is covered —
to them I offer for life, for long life, and for well-being.'
Thus.
And with the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances).
The conclusion of the rite is as stated previously.
'O water, refresh [him] with cool [water]';

children.text: uṣṇena vāya udakenedhīti taptā itarābhiḥ saṃsṛjya ārdradānava stha jīvadān avasthondatīriṣamāvadety apo 'bhimantrya dakṣiṇaṃ keśāntam abhyundyāt /
children.translated_text: 'O water, moistening one, moisten [him]';
'[I cut] for splendor, for beauty, for vigor' — with these [mantras] he cuts [the hair] to the right with a razor of <s>udumbara</s> (fig-tree) wood — [or] with an iron [razor].
'The razor with which <s>Savitṛ</s>, the knowing one, shaved King <s>Soma</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,
with that, O <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, shave this one here; may he be endowed with wealth, food, and prosperity.'

children.text: dakṣiṇasmin keśānte darbham ūrdhvāgraṃ nidadhāti // VGrs_4.9
children.translated_text: With these two [verses] on the left.
In front: 'The razor is the companion of <s>Savitṛ</s>.'

children.text: svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīr iti kṣureṇābhinidadhāti // VGrs_4.11
children.translated_text: Behind: 'Each of your hairs.'

children.text: yenāvapatsavitā kṣureṇa somasya rājño varuṇasya vidvān /
children.translated_text: In each [direction] thrice with: 'The three times [I cut].'

children.text: tena brahmāṇo vapatedam asyāyuṣmān ayaṃ jaradaṣṭir yathāsat /
children.translated_text: One should not shave [a child] under three years of age. After that, according to family custom.
He should store the hair in a cow-pen, or place it in water.
Having bathed [the child], he should dress him in new garments and adorn him. Then he feeds [people] according to his ability.

children.text: dakṣiṇato mātānyā vāvidhavānaḍuhena gomayenābhūmigatān keśān parigṛhṇīyāt // VGrs_4.13
children.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, [Chapter] 5.

children.text: mā te keśān anugād varca etattathā dhātā dadhātu te /
children.translated_text: In the eighth year he initiates a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>;

children.text: tubhyamindro varuṇo bṛhaspatiḥ savitā varca ādadhuḥ /
children.translated_text: in the eleventh, a <s>Kṣatriya</s>;
in the twelfth, a <s>Vaiśya</s>.

children.text: tena dharmeṇa punar apo 'bhimantryāparaṃ keśāntam abhyundyād uttaraṃ ca // VGrs_4.15
children.translated_text: Or before the sixteenth year.

children.text:
anyau tu pravapanau yena pūṣā bṛhaspater agner indrasya cāyuṣe 'vapat /
tena te vapāmyāyuṣe dīrghāyutvāya svastaye /
children.translated_text: A <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who has not been initiated by the sixteenth year, a <s>Kṣatriya</s> by the twenty-second, a <s>Vaiśya</s> by the twenty-fourth —
they become <s>Vrātyas</s> (outcastes), excluded from <s>Sāvitrī</s> [initiation].

children.text: yena bhūyaś caratyayaṃ jyok ca paśyasi sūryam /
children.translated_text: There is no rite of expiation for them.

children.text: tena te vapāmy āyuṣe dīrghāyutvāya suślokyāya suvarcase /
children.translated_text: If they desire, the rite of <s>Vrātyastoma</s> [may be performed for them].

Having set up the fire, having swept [the ground], having spread [the grass], having sprinkled [water], he seats the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> to the south of the fire and [places] the water vessel to the north, containing <s>śamī</s> (acacia) wood.

children.text: yat kṣureṇa parcayatā supeśasā vaptar vapasi keśān /
children.translated_text: Having consecrated [the water] as stated previously, he should use those [waters] for the water-rites: for sprinkling, for pouring over, and for bathing.

Having prepared the clarified butter, having addressed the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, having placed the fuel-stick, having poured the two <s>āghāra</s> oblations, having offered the two portions of <s>ājya</s>,

children.text: iti lohāyasaṃ kṣuraṃ keśavāpāya prayacchati // VGrs_4.17
children.translated_text: in the fire he offers with: 'O <s>Agni</s>, to you who are the lord of vows — to that lord of vows I have come; to that lord of vows may I be. O lord, place this vow upon me, <s>svāhā</s>!'

children.text: yathārthaṃ keśayatnān kurvanti dakṣiṇataḥ kapardā vasiṣṭhānām ubhayato 'tribhārgavakāśyapānāṃ pañcacūḍā āṅgirasaḥ śikhino 'nye // VGrs_4.18
children.translated_text: 'May <s>Agni</s> bestow upon me understanding, offspring, splendor; may <s>Indra</s> bestow upon me understanding, offspring, vigor;
may <s>Sūrya</s> bestow upon me understanding, offspring, radiance. What your radiance is, O <s>Agni</s>, may I thereby become radiant, <s>svāhā</s>!'

children.text: tryāyuṣaṃ kaśyapasya jamadagnes tryāyuṣam agastyasya tryāyuṣam /
children.translated_text: And [with the mantra]: 'O God, giver of life.'

children.text: yad devānāṃ tryāyuṣaṃ tan me astu śatāyuṣam /
children.translated_text: And with the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s>.
The conclusion of the rite is as stated previously.

children.text: parigṛhya gomayena keśān uttarapūrvasyāṃ gṛhasya mūṣyām antarā gehāt paladaṃ ca nidadhyāt /
children.translated_text: With a girdle of <s>muñja</s> grass he girds the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, with a bowstring the <s>Kṣatriya</s>, with wool the <s>Vaiśya</s>.
[Using the mantra:] 'This is <s>Sarasvatī</s>; she is the guardian of immortality; having put on this belt, become pure for the ritual.'

children.text: uptvāya keśāntān varuṇāya rājño bṛhaspatiḥ savitā viṣṇurindraḥ /
children.translated_text: 'An ascetic [maiden] she came. This maiden became a garment of <s>Soma</s>. She girds herself with faith and is the sister of the <s>Ṛṣis</s>.'

children.text: tebhyo nidhānaṃ mahad anvavindann antarā dyāvāpṛthivī apa svaḥ // VGrs_4.21
children.translated_text: 'With radiance and brahmanic glory.'

He gives [the student] a staff of <s>palāśa</s> (sacred fig) [for a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>], of <s>nyagrodha</s> (banyan) [for a <s>Kṣatriya</s>], of <s>udumbara</s> (fig) [for a <s>Vaiśya</s>]. He should carry [one] that has not been damaged by worms.
'This staff that has fallen from the sky upon the earth,

children.text: pakṣmaguṇaṃ tilapiśitaṃ ca keśavāpāya prayacchati // VGrs_4.23
children.translated_text: I have taken it up, with all the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, for [the vow of] celibacy.'
He gives [the student] a skin: an antelope skin for a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, a deer skin for a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, a goat skin for a <s>Vaiśya</s>.
'The skin that <s>Aditi</s> endowed with <s>brahman</s>,
woven by the sages — with that [skin] as firm armor, I cover you; live to a hundred autumns.'
'You are the protector of <s>brahman</s>.'
The garment: linen for a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, flax for a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, hemp for a <s>Vaiśya</s>.
'In the manner in which <s>Bṛhaspati</s> placed the garment of immortality upon <s>Indra</s>,

body.translated_text: Then he consecrates him [with the mantras]: 'Those of golden color, the pure ones' — with these four [verses]; with the <s>anuvāka</s> (section) 'Those herbs'; 'May the divine waters be auspicious for us for drinking, may they flow toward us auspiciously for our welfare; may the waters be dear and auspicious to us on the dry land, auspicious to us

children.translated_text: so I wrap you around, for the sake of long life and old age, for the sake of strength and radiance.'
Looking at [the student], he recites: 'Together with <s>Indra</s>, I set this one in motion for long life.'
Approaching [the fire], grasping [the student's] hand, filling [the student's] joined palms with water, looking toward the sun, he says:

body.text: tato garbhaikādaśeṣu kṣatriyaṃ garbhadvādaśeṣu vaiśyam // VGrs_5.2
body.translated_text: 'Who hands you over? To whom does he hand you over? Love! To love he hands you over!'

children.text: prākṣoḍaśād varṣād brāhmaṇasyāpatitā sāvitrī dvāviṃśāt kṣatriyasya caturviṃśād vaiśyasya /
children.translated_text: '<s>Bṛhaspati</s> hands you over. To <s>Bṛhaspati</s> he hands you over. <s>Agni</s> is your teacher.'
'I hand you over to <s>Prajāpati</s>. To <s>Prajāpati</s> I hand you over.' Then: 'I hand you over to God <s>Savitṛ</s>.'

children.text: nainān yājayeyur nādhyāpayeyur na vivaheyur na vivāhayeyuḥ // VGrs_5.3
children.translated_text: Then, having made him ascend [the stone], standing to the east of the fire while facing west, he teaches him:

body.translated_text: 'You are a student.' 'Sip water.' 'Do your work.' 'Put on fuel.' 'Sip water.' 'Do not sleep during the day.'
Repeating [the <s>Gāyatrī</s>]: he teaches [the student] the <s>Sāvitrī</s> [verse] quarter by quarter, then half by half, then completely.

body.text: kumāraṃ paryuptinaṃ snātam abhyaktaśirasam upasparśanakalpe nopaspṛṣṭam agnerdakṣiṇato 'vasthāpya dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam iti dadhnaḥ kumāraṃ triḥ prāśayet // VGrs_5.6
body.translated_text: In the first year, or in the third year, or before the time of the <s>Veda</s> study.

body.text:
iyaṃ duruktāt paribādhamānā varṇaṃ pavitraṃ punatī na āgāt /
prāṇāpānābhyāṃ balam ābhajantī śivā devī subhagā mekhaleyam /

children.text: ṛtasya goptrī tapasas tarutrī ghnatī rakṣaḥ sahamānā arātīḥ /
children.translated_text: 'This student, O God <s>Savitṛ</s>, is yours; protect him; may he not die.'

children.text: sā mā samantam anuparyehi bhadre dhartāras te subhage mekhale mā riṣāma /
children.translated_text: He entrusts him to the waters: 'Whatever is injurious in the waters for this [student], remove that.'

children.text: iti mauñjīṃ triguṇāṃ triḥ parivītāṃ mekhalām ābadhnīte /
children.translated_text: He entrusts him to the herbs: 'Whatever is injurious in the herbs for this [student], remove that.'

children.text: maurvīṃ dhanurjyāṃ kṣatriyasya śāṇīṃ vaiśyasya // VGrs_5.7
children.translated_text: He entrusts him to heaven and earth: 'O heaven and earth, whatever is harmful, remove that.'

children.text: upavītam asi yajñasya tvopavītenopavyayāmīti yajñopavītam // VGrs_5.8
children.translated_text: 'O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, endow this [student] with splendor and the radiance of <s>brahman</s>.'

children.text:
yā akṛtan yā atanvan yā avāyan yā avāharan /
yāś cāgnā devīr antān abhito 'tanvata tāstvā devīr jarase saṃvyayantām /
āyuṣmān ayaṃ paridhatta vāsaḥ paridhatta varcaḥ /
śatāyuṣaṃ kṛṇuhi dīrghamāyuḥ /
children.translated_text: 'May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> bestow upon this [student] understanding and wisdom.'

children.text: śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīr vasūni cāyyo vibhajāya jīyān /
children.translated_text: 'What your splendor is, O <s>Agni</s>, may I thereby become splendid.'

children.text: ity ahataṃ vāsa ācchādya mitrasya cakṣurdharaṇaṃ balīyastejo yaśasvi sthaviraṃ ca dhṛṣṇu /
children.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, the eating of food, the drinking [of Soma], the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> — may the <s>Viśvedevas</s> (all-gods) place these in me!'

children.text: anāhanasyaṃ vasanaṃ cariṣṇu parīdaṃ vājyaṃ vājinaṃ dadhe 'ham /
children.translated_text: Then he places [fuel] on the fire: 'To <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Soma</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!'
'O <s>Agni</s>, to you who are the lord of vows — to that lord of vows I have come; to that lord of vows may I be. O lord, place this vow upon me, <s>svāhā</s>!'

children.text: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvāṣṭau jaṭākaraṇīyān juhuyāt // VGrs_5.10
children.translated_text: And [with the mantra]: 'O God, giver of life.'
And with the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s>.
The conclusion of the rite is as stated previously.

children.text: kālāya vāṃ gotrāya vāṃ jaitrāya vām audbhetrāya vām annādyāya vām avanenijed ity udakenāñjaliṃ pūrayitvā sukṛtāya vāmiti pāṇī prakṣālya idamahaṃ duryamanyā niṣplāvayāmīty ācamya niṣṭhīvati // VGrs_5.13
children.translated_text: 'For your sake — for [your] lineage — for [your] victory — for [your] emergence — for the enjoyment of food' — having filled the palms with water, he washes [them, saying]: 'For [your] merit' — having washed both hands: 'I hereby wash away all that is of ill will' — then he sips and spits.

children.text: bhrātṛvyāṇāṃ sapatnānām ahaṃ bhūyāsam uttama iti dvitīyam // VGrs_5.14
children.translated_text: 'May I be the highest among rivals and competitors' — [he recites] a second time.

children.text: prātar jitaṃ bhagamugraṃ huvema vayaṃ putram aditeryo vidhartā /
children.translated_text: 'In the morning we invoke the won, the fortune, the mighty one, the son of <s>Aditi</s>, the arranger;

children.text: ādhraś cidyaṃ mantamānasturaś cidrājā cidyaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣīmahīty āha /
children.translated_text: even the poor man contemplating [him], even the swift man, even the king — may we partake of fortune!'
Thus he worships the sun.

children.text: brahmacaryam upāgāmupa mā hvayasveti brūyāt // VGrs_5.16
children.translated_text: 'I have entered upon celibacy (<s>brahmacarya</s>); call me [unto it]' — he should say.

children.text: ehi brahmopehi brahma brahma tvā sa brahmasantam upanayāmy aham asāv iti // VGrs_5.17
children.translated_text: 'Come, O <s>brahman</s>; approach, O <s>brahman</s>; O <s>brahman</s>, I, so-and-so, initiate you who are imbued with <s>brahman</s>.'
Then he takes his [student's] respectful greeting name.

children.text: devasya te savituḥ prasave 'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāmy aham asāv ity asya hastaṃ dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇam uttānam abhīvāṅguṣṭham abhīva lomāni gṛhṇīyāt // VGrs_5.19
children.translated_text: With the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with the arms of the two Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take your hand, O so-and-so — thus he should grasp his [the bride’s] right hand with his right hand, palm upward, thumb included, in the direction of the hair. // VGrs_5.19

children.text: mām evānvetu te mano māmevāpi tvam anvihi /
children.translated_text: Let your mind follow me alone; may you too follow me alone.

children.text: agnau dhṛtamiva dīpyatāṃ hṛdayaṃ tava yan mayi /
children.translated_text: Let your heart blaze toward me as ghee placed in the fire.
Thus she gazes at him who is looking [at her]. // VGrs_5.20

children.text: pṛṣṭhato 'sya pāṇim anvavahṛtya hṛdayadeśam anvārabhya japet prāṇānāṃ granthir asi sa mā visrasad iti /
children.translated_text: Drawing his hand behind him and placing it upon the region of the heart, he should mutter: ‘You are the knot of <s>prāṇas</s> (life-breaths); may it not come undone.’
‘You are the knot of <s>Brahman</s>’ — [placing it] upon the region of the navel. // VGrs_5.21

children.text: gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnām upamaśravastamam /
children.translated_text: We invoke you, O <s>Gaṇapati</s> (lord of hosts) of the <s>gaṇas</s>, the poet of poets, of highest fame,

children.text: jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇaspata ā naḥ kṛṇvann ūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam /
children.translated_text: the chief king, <s>Brahman</s>, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, come to us with your aids; be seated at the seat of sacrifice.
With this [verse] he should lead [the bride] around the fire keeping it to the right. // VGrs_5.22
Behind the fire he sits down on <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass), and the <s>brahmacārin</s> (student) to the south. // VGrs_5.23

children.text: adhīhi bho ity upaviśya japati // VGrs_5.24
children.translated_text: Having sat down, saying ‘Teach, sir!’ he mutters [the prayers]. // VGrs_5.24

children.text: prabhujya dakṣiṇaṃ jānuṃ pāṇī saṃdhāya darbhahastāv oṃ ity uktvā vyāhṛtīḥ sāvitrīṃ cānubrūyāt /
children.translated_text: Bending his right knee, joining his palms with <s>darbha</s> grass in hand, having said ‘Oṃ’, he should repeat the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances) and the <s>Sāvitrī</s> (verse).
Likewise in the recitation of the <s>kāṇḍas</s> (sections). // VGrs_5.25
‘That excellent [splendor] of <s>Savitṛ</s>’ — the <s>Gāyatrī</s> [meter] for a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>;

children.text: ā devo yātu savitā suratna iti triṣṭubhaṃ kṣatriyāya /
children.translated_text: ‘May the god <s>Savitṛ</s> come with beautiful jewels’ — the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [meter] for a <s>kṣatriya</s>;
‘They yoke the mind’ — the <s>Jagatī</s> [meter] for a <s>vaiśya</s>.
Later, [he teaches it] half-verse by half-verse, and entirely at the end. // VGrs_5.26

children.text: pālāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati naiyagrodhaṃ kṣatriyāyāśvatthaṃ vaiśyāya /
children.translated_text: He gives a staff of <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) wood to a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, of <s>nyagrodha</s> (banyan) to a <s>kṣatriya</s>, and of <s>aśvattha</s> (sacred fig) to a <s>vaiśya</s>.
‘O renowned one, make me renowned!

children.text: yathā tvaṃ suśravaḥ suśravā asy evam ahaṃ suśravaḥ suśravā bhūyāsam /
children.translated_text: Just as you, O renowned one, are well-renowned, so may I become renowned and well-renowned!

children.text: yathā tvaṃ devānāṃ vedasya nidhigopo 'syevamahaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ brahmaṇo nidhigopo bhūyāsamiti pratigṛhṇāti // VGrs_5.27
children.translated_text: Just as you are the treasure-keeper of the <s>Veda</s> of the gods, so may I become the treasure-keeper of the <s>Brahman</s> (sacred knowledge) of men!’ — thus he receives [the staff]. // VGrs_5.27

children.text:
ūrdhvakapālo brāhmaṇasya kamaṇḍaluḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ kṣatriyasya nicalkalo vaiśyasya /
imā āpaḥ prabharāmy ayakṣmā yakṣmacātanīḥ /
children.translated_text:
The <s>kamaṇḍalu</s> (water vessel) of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> has its opening upward; that of a <s>kṣatriya</s> is round; that of a <s>vaiśya</s> is flat-based.
‘These waters I bring forth, free from disease, dispelling disease;
with <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) I bring forth these waters, together with immortality and life-span.’

children.text: iti pratigṛhṇāmīti pratigṛhya bhaikṣyacaryaṃ caret bhavati bhikṣāṃ dehīti brāhmaṇaḥ bhavati madhyāṃ kṣatriyaḥ bhavaty antyāṃ vaiśyaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having said ‘I receive [them]’ and receiving [the vessel], he should go on the begging round. A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> says ‘Please give alms’ [at the beginning]; a <s>kṣatriya</s> in the middle; a <s>vaiśya</s> at the end.
Four, six, or eight [women should be asked], who are not widows and who do not refuse.
Some [say] the mother first. // VGrs_5.28
Having offered [the alms] to the teacher, // VGrs_5.29

children.text:
vāgyataḥ prāg grāmāt saṃdhyām āset /
tiṣṭhanpūrvām /
children.translated_text:
maintaining silence, he should sit at the <s>saṃdhyā</s> (twilight) east of the village.
Standing [for] the morning [twilight].

children.text: sāvitrīṃ trir adhītya adhvanām adhvapate svastyasyādhvanaḥ pāramaśīya /
children.translated_text: Having recited the <s>Sāvitrī</s> three times: ‘O lord of paths, may we reach the far shore of this path safely.’

children.text: yā medhā apsaraḥsu gandharveṣu ca yanmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: ‘That wisdom which is among the <s>Apsarases</s> and <s>Gandharvas</s>, and that mind,

children.text: yā medhā daivī mānuṣī sā mām āviśatām iha /
children.translated_text: that wisdom which is divine and human — may it enter into me here.’
Thus. // VGrs_5.30
Having returned, he should attend to the fire.
‘Praise this hymn’ — with this he should sweep around [the fire].
‘You are fuel; may we prosper’ — with this he places a fuel-stick.
‘You are a fuel-stick; may we prosper together’ — [with this he places] a second one. // VGrs_5.31
‘I have today followed the waters’ — with this he worships. // VGrs_5.32

children.text: taṃ mā saṃsṛja varcaseti mukhaṃ parimṛjīta // VGrs_5.33
children.translated_text: ‘Join me with splendor’ — with this he should wipe his face. // VGrs_5.33

children.text:
yadagne tapasā tapo brahmacaryam upemasi /
priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyasmāyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ /
children.translated_text: ‘O <s>Agni</s>, through the <s>tapas</s> (austerity) with which we have approached the <s>brahmacarya</s> (student discipline), may we become dear to learning, long-lived, and of good wisdom!’
‘O <s>Agni</s>, I have brought a fuel-stick to the great <s>Jātavedas</s> (fire);

children.text: sa me śraddhāṃ ca medhāṃ ca jātavedāḥ prayacchatu /
children.translated_text: may <s>Jātavedas</s> grant me faith and wisdom.’
<s>Svāhā</s>!
With this he places a fuel-stick. // VGrs_5.34

children.text: tejasā mā samaṅgdhi varcasā mā samaṅgdhi brahmavarcasena mā samaṅgdhīti mukhaṃ parimṛjīta // VGrs_5.35
children.translated_text: ‘Anoint me with radiance, anoint me with splendor, anoint me with the splendor of sacred knowledge (<s>brahmavarcas</s>)’ — with this he should wipe his face. // VGrs_5.35

children.text: āyurdhā agne 'sīti yathārūpaṃ gātrāṇi saṃmṛśati // VGrs_5.36
children.translated_text: ‘You are the giver of life, O <s>Agni</s>’ — with this he touches his limbs in the appropriate manner. // VGrs_5.36

children.text: iha dhṛtiriti paryāyair aṃsaṃ grīvāścārcirālabhya rucaṃ no dhehīti lalāṭam abhimṛśet // VGrs_5.37
children.translated_text: ‘Here is steadfastness’ — with these alternative [formulas] he touches the shoulder and neck; having touched [them] with the word ‘flame’ (<s>arci</s>), he should touch the forehead [saying] ‘Bestow upon us splendor.’ // VGrs_5.37
Sprinkling of water [should be done] at the beginning and end. // VGrs_5.38

children.text: gurave brahmaṇe ca varam uttarāsaṅgaṃ ca dadāti // VGrs_5.39
children.translated_text: He gives a garment of distinction and an upper garment to the teacher and to the officiating <s>brāhmaṇa</s>. // VGrs_5.39
He should eat food without alkali or salt for twelve nights. // VGrs_5.40
Some [say] without alkali [only]. // VGrs_5.41

children.text: vyuṣṭe dvādaśarātre ṣaḍrātre vā grāmāt prācīṃ vodīcīṃ vā diśam upaniṣkramya paścāt palāśasya yajñīyasya vā vṛkṣasya sāvitreṇa sthālīpākeneṣṭvā jayaprabhṛtibhiścājyasya purastāt sviṣṭakṛto mekhalāṃ daṇḍaṃ cāpsu prāsyet // VGrs_5.42
children.translated_text: When the twelve nights have passed — or six nights — going forth from the village in an easterly or northerly direction, behind a <s>palāśa</s> or sacrificially suitable tree, having offered with the <s>sthālīpāka</s> (cooked grain offering) accompanied by the <s>Sāvitrī</s> verse, and with oblations of ghee with the <s>jaya</s> and other [formulas] before the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> (offering to the fire-maker), he should cast the girdle (<s>mekhalā</s>) and staff into the waters. // VGrs_5.42
The scripture says that he should eat the remainder of the oblation right there. // VGrs_5.43

body.translated_text: Then he entrusts him to the sun:

children.translated_text: From the <s>upanayana</s> (initiation) onward, he should observe the vow. // VGrs_6.1
The instructions for vows have been explained through [the rules of] the <s>upanayana</s>. // VGrs_6.2

children.text: mārgavāsāḥ saṃhatakeśaḥ bhaikṣācaryavṛttiḥ saśalkadaṇḍaḥ saptamauñjīṃ mekhalāṃ dhārayed ācāryasyāpratikūlaḥ sarvakārī // VGrs_6.3
children.translated_text: Clad in deer-hide, with matted hair, subsisting by begging for alms, carrying a staff with bark, he should wear a triple girdle of <s>muñja</s> grass; he should be obedient to the teacher and do everything [for him]. // VGrs_6.3
Whatever comes to him, he should give to him [the teacher].
[That] by which one is joined with many. // VGrs_6.4
He should not sit on his [the teacher’s] bed. // VGrs_6.5
He should not mount a chariot. // VGrs_6.6
He should not sleep [in the same place as the teacher]. // VGrs_6.7
He should not chatter for amusement. // VGrs_6.8
He should not wear gold ornaments for the sake of appearance. // VGrs_6.9
He should avoid all physical contact with women. // VGrs_6.10
He should not bathe [by immersing himself] like a stick. // VGrs_6.11
He should not go near water [unnecessarily]. // VGrs_6.12
He should not sleep during the day. // VGrs_6.13
He should observe <s>brahmacarya</s> (student discipline) in the three <s>Vedas</s>. // VGrs_6.14
With senses restrained, he should subsist by begging morning and evening. // VGrs_6.15
He should attend to the fire morning and evening. // VGrs_6.16

children.text: adhaḥśāyī ācāryādhīnavṛttiḥ tannisargād aśanam ayācitaṃ lavaṇam // VGrs_6.17
children.translated_text: Sleeping on the ground, living subject to the teacher’s authority — by his permission he may eat food, unsolicited, with salt. // VGrs_6.17
He should eat in silence. // VGrs_6.18
He should avoid honey and meat. // VGrs_6.19

children.text: acchannavastrāṃ vivṛtāṃ striyaṃ na paśyet // VGrs_6.20
children.translated_text: He should not look upon a woman who is uncovered or exposed. // VGrs_6.20
He should carry a staff of <s>yaupya</s> wood. // VGrs_6.21
He should not strike a cow or a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> with it. // VGrs_6.22
He should not go to dances or songs. // VGrs_6.23
Nor should he perform them. // VGrs_6.24
He should not scratch [on the ground]. // VGrs_6.25
He should have a tuft of matted hair, or all his hair matted. // VGrs_6.26
He should wear garments of hemp, linen, or skin. // VGrs_6.27

children.text: raktaṃ vasanakambalam aiṇeyaṃ brāhmaṇasya rauravaṃ kṣatriyasya ājaṃ vaiśyasya // VGrs_6.28
children.translated_text: A dyed woolen blanket: of deer-skin for a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, of <s>raurava</s> (a type of deer) skin for a <s>kṣatriya</s>, of goat-skin for a <s>vaiśya</s>. // VGrs_6.28

children.text: etena dharmeṇa dvādaśavarṣāṇy ekavede brahmacaryaṃ caret /
children.translated_text: By this rule he should observe <s>brahmacarya</s> for twelve years in one <s>Veda</s>,

children.text: caturviṃśati dvayoḥ ṣaṭtriṃśati trayāṇām aṣṭācatvāriṃśati sarveṣām /
children.translated_text: twenty-four for two, thirty-six for three, forty-eight for all;
or until mastery [is achieved]. // VGrs_6.29

children.text: malajñurabalaḥ kṛśaḥ snātvā sa sarvaṃ labhate yat kiṃcin manasepsitamiti // VGrs_6.30
children.translated_text: Dirty, emaciated, and thin — having bathed, he obtains everything whatsoever that the mind desires. // VGrs_6.30
By this rule one learns well. // VGrs_6.31

children.text: mantrabrāhmaṇānyadhītya kalpaṃ mīmāṃsāṃ ca yājñiko 'dhītya vaktraṃ padaṃ smṛtiṃ caicchikaḥ // VGrs_6.32
children.translated_text: Having studied the <s>mantras</s> and <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> together with the <s>Kalpa</s> (ritual manual) and <s>Mīmāṃsā</s> (philosophical exegesis), one becomes a <s>yājñika</s> (ritualist); having studied the phonetics (<s>vaktra</s>), etymology (<s>pada</s>), and traditional law (<s>smṛti</s>), one becomes an <s>aicchika</s> (one who follows a particular school). // VGrs_6.32
Both are <s>snātakas</s> (those who have completed their studies). // VGrs_6.33
The other is a <s>śrotriya</s> (learned in scripture), a reciter of the <s>Veda</s>.
For him there is no [ceremonial] bathing. // VGrs_6.34
Having sat down, the <s>ācamana</s> (ritual sipping) is prescribed.

children.text: antarjānu bāhū kṛtvā trir ācāmet // VGrs_6.35
children.translated_text: Placing both arms between the knees, he should sip three times. // VGrs_6.35
He should wipe [his lips] twice,
and touch the orifices on the head. // VGrs_6.36

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, Chapter 6

children.translated_text: Now the <s>cāturhotṛkī dīkṣā</s> (consecration for the four-priest ritual) [lasts] one year. // VGrs_7.1

children.text: āghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā caturhot n svakarmaṇo juhuyāt /
children.translated_text: Having offered the two <s>āghāras</s> (preliminary butter oblations), the <s>ājyabhāgas</s> (shares of clarified butter) to be offered as <s>āghāra</s>, and having made offerings of his own ritual act in the <s>caturhotra</s> (four-priest system),

children.text: saha pañcahotrā ṣaḍḍhotrā ca saptahotāram antataḥ // VGrs_7.2
children.translated_text: together with the <s>pañcahotra</s> (five-priest) and <s>ṣaḍḍhotra</s> (six-priest) [formulas], and the <s>saptahotṛ</s> (seven-priest) at the end. // VGrs_7.2

children.text: hutvā vrataṃ pradāyādito dvāv anuvākāv anuvācayet // VGrs_7.3
children.translated_text: Having offered, and having given the vow, he should have [the student] recite the first two <s>anuvākas</s> (sections). // VGrs_7.3

children.text: athāgnivratāśvamedhikī dīkṣā saṃvatsaraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ vā // VGrs_7.4
children.translated_text: Now the <s>agnivrata-āśvamedhikī dīkṣā</s> (consecration for the fire-vow and horse-sacrifice type) [lasts] one year or twelve nights. // VGrs_7.4

children.text: ākūtamagnimiti ṣaḍḍhutvā vrataṃ pradāyādito 'ṣṭāv anuvākān anuvācayet // VGrs_7.5
children.translated_text: ‘The intention is the fire’ — having offered six times, and having given the vow, he should have [the student] recite the first eight <s>anuvākas</s>. // VGrs_7.5

children.text: triṣavaṇam udakam āharet trīṃs trīn kumbhān // VGrs_7.6
children.translated_text: At the three <s>savanas</s> (pressings), he should bring water — three pots each time. // VGrs_7.6
And three bundles of fuel-sticks. // VGrs_7.7

children.text: bhasmani śayīta karīṣe sikatāsu bhūmau vā // VGrs_7.8
children.translated_text: He should sleep on ashes, or on cow-dung, or on sand, or on the bare ground. // VGrs_7.8
He should not go near water [unnecessarily]. // VGrs_7.9

children.text: saṃvatsare samāpte ghṛtavatāpūpenāgnim iṣṭvā vātsapraṃ vācayet // VGrs_7.10
children.translated_text: When the year is completed, having offered to the fire with a cake mixed with ghee, he should have [the student] recite the <s>Vātsapra</s> [hymn]. // VGrs_7.10

children.text: smārtena yāvad adhyayanaṃ kāṇḍavrataviśeṣā homārthaś cādyantayor juhuyāt // VGrs_7.11
children.translated_text: According to the <s>smārta</s> (traditional) [rule], for the duration of study, the special vows for each <s>kāṇḍa</s> (section) — and for the purpose of the offering, he should make oblations at the beginning and end. // VGrs_7.11
Then he should entrust him [to the deities]: ‘I entrust you to <s>Agni</s>.’
‘I entrust you to <s>Vāyu</s>.’
‘I entrust you to <s>Sūrya</s>.’
‘I entrust you to <s>Prajāpati</s>.’ // VGrs_7.12
By this very [procedure] the <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice) [type of recitation] is explained. // VGrs_7.13
Having offered with the ninth <s>anuvāka</s>, he should worship with the tenth. // VGrs_7.14
He should approach grass, a watering-place, and water for the horse. // VGrs_7.15
With these two very mantras, he should undertake the vow of the <s>traividyaka</s> (one who studies the three <s>Vedas</s>). // VGrs_7.16
One who wishes to study the secret [teaching undertakes] the <s>pravargya</s> rite. // VGrs_7.17
For that secret [study], there is the offering for the vow and the <s>saminmantra</s> (fuel-stick mantra). // VGrs_7.18

children.text: tiṣṭhed ahani rātrāv āsīta vāgyataḥ // VGrs_7.19
children.translated_text: He should stand during the day and sit at night, with speech restrained. // VGrs_7.19
And thus it should be on the <s>parvan</s> (junction) days. // VGrs_7.20
And he should wear all his hair matted. // VGrs_7.21
The <s>pravargya</s> rite lasts at minimum one year. // VGrs_7.22

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, Chapter 7

children.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, 8
During the rainy season, he commences the Vedic lessons on [the <s>nakṣatra</s>] <s>Śravaṇa</s>,
or on <s>Hasta</s>;
on [the full moon of] <s>Prauṣṭhapadī</s>, some say. // VGrs_8.1

body.text:
atha juhoti /
apvā nāmāsi tasyāste joṣṭrīṃ gameyam /
aham iddhi pituḥ pari medhā amṛtasya jagrabha /
ahaṃ sūrya ivājani /
svāhā /
apvo nāmāsi tasya te joṣṭraṃ gameyam /

children.text: aham iddhi pituḥ pari medhā amṛtasya jagrabha /
children.translated_text: 'I have grasped wisdom from the father, from the immortal;'
'I have shone forth like the sun;'
'<s>Svāhā</s>!'
Thus. // VGrs_8.2
'You are named <s>Sumati</s> (good thought);'
'You are named <s>Sarasvatī</s>;'
'You are named <s>Sarasvān</s>;'

children.text: tasyāste tasya te ity anuṣajet // VGrs_8.3
children.translated_text: He should add 'of that, of you' [to each]. // VGrs_8.3

children.text:
yuje svāhā /
prayuje svāhā /
saṃyuje svāhā /
udyuje svāhā /
children.translated_text:
'I yoke — <s>svāhā</s>!
I yoke forth — <s>svāhā</s>!
I yoke together — <s>svāhā</s>!
I yoke up — <s>svāhā</s>!'

children.text: udyujyamānāya svāheti jayaprabhṛtibhiś cājyasya purastāt sviṣṭakṛto 'ntevāsināṃ yogam icchann atha japati ṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi brahma vadiṣyāmi tan mām avatu tadvaktāram avatv avatu māmavatu vaktāram /
children.translated_text: 'To the one being yoked up — <s>svāhā</s>!' — with these [mantras] beginning with '<s>jaya</s>' (victory) and others, [he makes oblations] of ghee before the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> oblation. Desiring the union of the pupils, he then recites: 'I shall speak <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), I shall speak <s>satya</s> (truth), I shall speak <s>Brahman</s>...'

children.text: vāṅ me manasi pratiṣṭhitā mano me vāci pratiṣṭhitam āvir āyur mayi dhehi /
children.translated_text: 'May my speech be established in my mind, may my mind be established in my speech. O Self-manifest one, place lifespan in me!'
'You are the voice of the <s>Veda</s>!'
'May the meters attend upon [us]; we commence the [Vedic] lessons!' // VGrs_8.4

children.text: oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svariti darbhapāṇis triḥ sāvitrīm adhītyāditaś ca trīn anuvākāṃs tathāṅgānām ekaikam /
children.translated_text: '<s>Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar</s>' — holding <s>darbha</s> grass, having recited the <s>Sāvitrī</s> three times, and from the beginning three <s>anuvākas</s> (sections) and one each of the auxiliary [texts].
And [the hymn beginning] 'Who yokes you?' // VGrs_8.5
The occasions of non-study (<s>anadhyāya</s>) for that [student] are:

children.text: sataḥ valīkakṣāraprabhṛti varṣaṃ na vidyotamāne na stanayatīti śrutiḥ ākālikaṃ devatu mūlaṃ vidyuddhanvolkātyakṣarāḥ śabdāḥ ācāreṇānye // VGrs_8.6
children.translated_text: From the appearance of lightning, cloud-masses, etc. during the rains: 'When there is no lightning and no thunder' — this is the <s>śruti</s> (revealed text). Untimely [thunder] up to the divine root [<s>nakṣatra</s>], lightning, meteors, and loud sounds [are causes for suspension]; others [determine suspension] by custom. // VGrs_8.6

children.text: ardhapañcamān māsān adhītya pañcārdhaṣaṣṭhān vā dīkṣaṇāyanaṃ vādhītyāthotsṛjanty etena dharmeṇa ṛtam avādiṣaṃ satyam avādiṣaṃ brahmāvādiṣaṃ tan mām āvīt tadvaktāram āvīd āvīn mām āvīd vaktāram /
children.translated_text: Having studied for four-and-a-half months, or five-and-a-half, or having studied up to the <s>dīkṣaṇāyana</s> (solstice), then they discontinue [study] with this procedure: 'I have spoken <s>ṛta</s>, I have spoken <s>satya</s>, I have spoken <s>Brahman</s>; may that protect me...'

children.text: vāṅ me manasi pratiṣṭhitā mano me vāci pratiṣṭhitam āvir āyur mayi dhehi /
children.translated_text: 'May my speech be established in my mind, may my mind be established in my speech. O Self-manifest one, place lifespan in me!'
'You are the voice of the <s>Veda</s>!'
'May the meters breathe back; we discontinue the [Vedic] lessons!' // VGrs_8.7

children.text: oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar ity antam adhītya ko vo vimuñcatīti ca // VGrs_8.8
children.translated_text: '<s>Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar</s>' — having recited to the end, and [the hymn] 'Who releases you?' // VGrs_8.8
One should not study on the night of the <s>pakṣiṇī</s> (full moon),
or on both [full and new moon nights]. // VGrs_8.9
And not above that [period] when there are clouds. // VGrs_8.10
Untimely lightning, thunder, and rain, and [regular] rain. // VGrs_8.11
Now, those worthy of the <s>Upaniṣad</s> [secret teaching]:

children.text: brahmacārī sucaritī medhāvī karmakṛd dhanadaḥ priyaḥ vidyayā vā vidyām anvicchan // VGrs_8.12
children.translated_text: A <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student) of good conduct, intelligent, diligent in ritual action, generous, agreeable, or one seeking knowledge through learning. // VGrs_8.12
These are the sacred fords of <s>Brahman</s>. // VGrs_8.13
<s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, 9
The <s>godāna</s> (gift of a cow / first shaving) [ceremony is performed] for one of sixteen years;
or for one about to undertake the [sacred] fire;
the <s>Maitrāyaṇī</s> [school holds] the <s>godāna</s> with [the establishment of] fire. // VGrs_9.1

body.translated_text: The mantra-procedure is stated in the rule for making <s>jaṭā</s> (matted hair). // VGrs_9.2

children.translated_text: And there is an additional application of mantras for the private parts and the armpits.

children.text: yat kṣureṇa parcayatā supeśasā vaptar vapasi keśaśmaśrūn /
children.translated_text: 'When you shave with a well-sharpened razor, O barber, [as] you pare the hair and beard,
purify the head and face; do not rob [his] lifespan!'
Thus. // VGrs_9.3

body.translated_text: He should bury the hair in the ground. // VGrs_9.4
At the end, he should give a cow. // VGrs_9.5
When permitted by the teacher in the <s>Veda</s>, he should bathe [i.e., complete his studentship]. // VGrs_9.6

body.text: chandasy arthān buddhvā snāsyan gāṃ kārayet // VGrs_9.7
body.translated_text: Having understood the meanings in the Vedic texts, one about to bathe should have a cow prepared. // VGrs_9.7
He should honor the teacher. // VGrs_9.8

body.text: āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucaya iti catasṛbhiḥ snātvāhate vāsasī paridadhīta vasvasi vasumantaṃ māṃ kuru sauvarcasāya vāṃ tejase brahmavarcasāya paridadhānīti // VGrs_9.9
body.translated_text: Having bathed with the three [verses] '<s>āpo hi ṣṭhā</s>' and the four [verses] '<s>hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ</s>,' he should put on two new garments [saying:] 'You are <s>Vasu</s> (wealth); make me wealthy. For splendor, for brilliance, for <s>Brahman</s>'s...' // VGrs_9.9
'You are the shade of all people' — thus he holds up the umbrella. // VGrs_9.10

children.text: mālāmābadhnīte yām aśvinau dhārayetāṃ bṛhatīṃ puṣkarasrajam /
children.translated_text: He ties on a garland: 'That broad lotus-garland which the <s>Aśvins</s> would wear,
that garland approved by all the gods, I place upon [myself]!'
Thus. // VGrs_9.11

body.translated_text: 'You are splendor!' — thus he should wear gold. // VGrs_9.12

body.text: pratiṣṭhe stho devate mā mā saṃtāptam ityupānahau // VGrs_9.13
body.translated_text: 'You two are the foundation, O divine ones; do not cause me to be burnt!' — thus [he puts on] the sandals. // VGrs_9.13
'You are support!' — thus he should carry a bamboo staff. // VGrs_9.14
And a water-vessel (<s>kamaṇḍalu</s>) filled with water. // VGrs_9.15
The teachers say there are perpetual observances. // VGrs_9.16

children.translated_text: Henceforth he should wear two garments;
'A fine garment should be worn' — this is the <s>śruti</s>. // VGrs_9.17

body.text: āmantrya gurūn gurvadhīnāṃśca svān gṛhānvrajet // VGrs_9.18
body.translated_text: Having taken leave of the teachers and the teachers' wives, he should go to his own home. // VGrs_9.18

children.text: pratiṣiddham aparayā dvārā niḥsaraṇaṃ malavadvāsasā saha sambhāṣā rajasvadvāsasā saha śayyā gor guror duruktavacanam asthāne śayanaṃ sthānaṃ smayanaṃ yānaṃ gānaṃ smaraṇamiti /
children.translated_text: Prohibited are: exiting through the wrong door, conversing with one wearing soiled garments, sharing a bed with one wearing stained garments, speaking harsh words to a cow or the teacher, sleeping or standing in an improper place, laughing [improperly]...
He should avoid these. // VGrs_9.19
Performing sacrifices [for others] is his livelihood;
gleaning, gathering, [accepting] unsolicited gifts, or begging from virtuous people;
or, if [other means are] unsuccessful, the livelihood of a <s>Vaiśya</s> (agriculture and trade). // VGrs_9.20

body.translated_text: He should abandon occupations that conflict with Vedic study. // VGrs_9.21

children.text: vinītakrodhaḥ saharṣaḥ saharṣīṃ bhāryāṃ vindetānanyapūrvāṃ yavīyasīm // VGrs_10.1
children.translated_text: With anger subdued, joyful, he should find a joyful wife who has not been with another man before, and who is younger [than himself]. // VGrs_10.1
Marriage should be with those of different <s>pravara</s> (lineage designation);

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ saptamāt pitṛbandhubhyaḥ pañcamān mātṛbandhubhyo bījinaśca // VGrs_10.2
children.translated_text: removed by seven generations from paternal relatives and five from maternal relatives, and from the progenitor. // VGrs_10.2
He should choose [the bride] under the <s>nakṣatras</s> beginning with <s>Kṛttikā</s> and <s>Svāti</s>. // VGrs_10.3
He should marry under <s>Mṛgaśiras</s>, <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s>, or <s>Uttarā</s> [<s>nakṣatras</s>]. // VGrs_10.4

children.text: pañca vivāhakārakāṇi bhavanti vittaṃ rūpaṃ vidyā prajñā bāndhavamiti // VGrs_10.5
children.translated_text: There are five qualifications for marriage: wealth, beauty, learning, intelligence, and kinship. // VGrs_10.5
If one [quality] is lacking, he should forgo wealth;
if a second is lacking, beauty;
if a third is lacking, learning;

children.text: prajñāyāṃ tu bāndhave ca vivadante // VGrs_10.6
children.translated_text: but regarding intelligence and kinship, [the authorities] disagree. // VGrs_10.6

children.text: anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu panthā yebhiḥ sakhāyo yantu no vareyam /
children.translated_text: 'Free from thorns, may the paths be straight, by which our friends shall go to obtain the bride!

children.text: samaryamā saṃ bhago no 'nunīyāt saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamastu devāḥ /
children.translated_text: May <s>Aryaman</s> and <s>Bhaga</s> lead us together; may the union of husband and wife be well-ordered, O gods!'
Thus he blesses those going for the bride. // VGrs_10.7

children.text: bandhumatīṃ kanyām aspṛṣṭamaithunām upayacchetānagnikāṃ śreṣṭhām // VGrs_10.8
children.translated_text: He should marry a maiden who has relatives, who has not had sexual contact, who is not without fire — the best [bride]. // VGrs_10.8
He should perform a test of knowledge for her:

children.text: caturo loṣṭān āharet sītāloṣṭaṃ vediloṣṭaṃ gomayaloṣṭaṃ śmaśānaloṣṭaṃ ca // VGrs_10.9
children.translated_text: he should bring four clods of earth — a clod from a furrow, a clod from the altar, a clod of cow-dung, and a clod from a cremation ground. // VGrs_10.9
'Take one of these,' he should say.
If she takes the cremation-ground clod, he should not marry her. // VGrs_10.10

children.text: asaṃspṛṣṭāṃ dharmeṇopayaccheta brāhmeṇa śaulkena vā // VGrs_10.11
children.translated_text: He should marry an untouched [maiden] through the <s>Dharma</s> — either by the <s>Brāhma</s> rite or by the <s>Śaulka</s> (bride-price) rite. // VGrs_10.11
He should give a hundred [cows], or a chariot, or a pair of cattle. // VGrs_10.12

children.text: ubhayāṃs tejanīṣv āsej janyān kaumārikāṃś ca /
children.translated_text: He should seat both [parties] — the groom's party and the bride's party — on mats of <s>tejanī</s> grass;

children.text: pūrve janyāḥ syur apare kaumārikāḥ // VGrs_10.13
children.translated_text: the groom's party should be on the east [side], the bride's party on the west. // VGrs_10.13

children.text: caturo gomayapiṇḍān kṛtvā dvāv anyebhyas tathānyebhya iti prayacchet // VGrs_10.14
children.translated_text: Having made four lumps of cow-dung, he should give two to one [party] and likewise two to the other. // VGrs_10.14
He should make [the bride] step on a stone: 'Step on this stone; be firm like a stone!
Overcome the enemies; trample down the foes!'
Thus. // VGrs_10.15
'I accept' — three times, for a bride given by <s>Brahman</s>'s rite. // VGrs_10.16
With the prepared shoulder-portion, they should share [the food]. // VGrs_10.17
The <s>Māgadha</s> (bard) should call out '<s>Ānanda</s>!' (Joy!) three times. // VGrs_10.18

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, 10

children.text: ṣaḍarghyārhā bhavanti ṛtvigācāryo vivāhyo rājā snātakaḥ priyaśceti // VGrs_11.1
children.translated_text: Six persons are worthy of the <s>arghya</s> (honorific reception): the <s>ṛtvij</s> (priest), the <s>ācārya</s> (teacher), the bridegroom, the king, the <s>snātaka</s> (graduate), and a dear one. // VGrs_11.1
Those who do not [eat] food prepared [for a special occasion] are honored after a full year;

children.text: anyatra yājyāt karmaṇo vivāhāc ca // VGrs_11.2
children.translated_text: except for a sacrificial ritual and a wedding. // VGrs_11.2
One whose father is living should not accept the <s>arghya</s>. // VGrs_11.3
Then they honor him [as follows]. // VGrs_11.4

children.text: kāṃsye camase vā dadhani madhvāsicya varṣīyasāpidhāya virājo doho 'si virājo doho 'si virājo doham aśīya mayi dohaḥ padyāyai virāja iti madhuparkarmāhiyamāṇaṃ pratīkṣate // VGrs_11.5
children.translated_text: Having poured honey into curds in a bronze or wooden cup, covering it with something older [i.e., a large leaf], [reciting:] 'You are the milking of <s>Virāj</s>! You are the milking of <s>Virāj</s>! May I drink the milking of <s>Virāj</s>! May the milking be in me, in [my] feet, from <s>Virāj</s>!' — this is the <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-mixture) offering. // VGrs_11.5

children.text: sāvitreṇa viṣṭarau pratigṛhya rāṣṭrabhṛd asīty āsaṃdyām udagagram āstṛṇāti // VGrs_11.6
children.translated_text: Having received two bundles of grass with the <s>Sāvitrī</s> [mantra], he spreads [them] northward on the seat, [saying:] 'You are the support of the kingdom!' // VGrs_11.6

children.text: ahaṃ varṣma sadṛśānām udyatānām iva sūryaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'I am the summit of those who are equal to me, like the sun [among those who] rise!

children.text: idam ahaṃ tam adharaṃ karomi yo mā kaścābhidāsati /
children.translated_text: I make lower him who dares to oppose me.'
Saying thus, he sits on one [bundle]. // VGrs_11.7

children.text: mā tvadyoṣam ity anyataram adhastāt pādayor upakarṣati // VGrs_11.8
children.translated_text: 'May I not be separated from you!' — he draws one of the other [sandals] beneath [the guest's] feet. // VGrs_11.8
He addresses each one three times while [the guest is] seated on a grass-seat. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.9
He says 'Not at all, sir.'
'May I not be harmed.' // <s>VGrs</s> 11.10
The waters for sipping are offered first. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.11
Saying 'You are the spreading of immortality (<s>amṛtopastaraṇa</s>),' he sips. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.12
He washes [the guest's] feet with a verse. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.13
He touches the <s>argha</s> (respectful offering of water). // <s>VGrs</s> 11.14
Then he offers it forth. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.15

children.text: sāvitreṇobhayato viṣṭaraṃ madhuparkaṃ pratigṛhya adityās tvā pṛṣṭhe sādayāmīti bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpyāvasāyya suparṇasya tvā garutmataś cakṣuṣāvekṣa ityavekṣya namo rudrāya pātrasada iti prādeśena pratidiśaṃ vyuddiśyāṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā ca madhu vātā ṛtāyata iti tisṛbhiḥ saṃsṛjati // VGrs_11.16
children.translated_text: With the <s>Sāvitrī</s> [verse], receiving the <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-mixture) on both sides of the grass-seat, saying 'I seat you on the back of <s>Aditi</s>,' he places it on the ground; having set it down, saying 'I look upon you with the eye of <s>Suparṇa Garutmat</s> (the divine eagle),' he looks upon it; saying 'Homage to <s>Rudra</s> who sits in the vessel,' with a span-measure he dedicates it in each direction; with the thumb and middle finger, he mixes it with the three [verses] beginning with '<s>Madhu vātā ṛtāyate</s>' (The winds blow sweetly for the righteous). // <s>VGrs</s> 11.16

children.text: satyaṃ yaśaḥ śrīḥ śrayatāmiti triḥ prāśnāti bhūyiṣṭham // VGrs_11.17
children.translated_text: Saying 'May truth, glory, and prosperity attend [me],' he eats most of it three times. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.17
He gives the remainder to a friend. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.18
Saying 'You are the covering of immortality (<s>amṛtapidhāna</s>),' he sips. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.19
Holding a sword and grass-seat in hand, he addresses the cow. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.20

children.text: hato me pāpmā pāpmānaṃ me hata /
children.translated_text: 'My evil has been slain! Slay my evil!'

children.text: yāṃ tvā devā vasavo 'nvajīviṣur ādityānāṃ svasāraṃ rudramātaram /
children.translated_text: 'You whom the gods, the <s>Vasus</s>, depended upon for life, the sister of the <s>Ādityas</s>, the mother of the <s>Rudras</s>,

children.text: daivīṃ gāmaditiṃ janānām ārabhantām arhatām arhaṇāya /
children.translated_text: the divine cow, <s>Aditi</s> of the people — let the worthy ones commence for the sake of the worthy.'
He commands: '<s>Oṃ</s>, do it!' // <s>VGrs</s> 11.21

children.text: catur avarān brāhmaṇān nānāgotrān ityekaikaṃ paśvaṅgaṃ pāyasaṃ vā bhojayet // VGrs_11.22
children.translated_text: He should feed four or more <s>brāhmaṇas</s> of different <s>gotras</s>, one portion of the animal each, or milk-rice. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.22

children.text: yadyutsṛjet mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānām amṛtasya nābhiḥ /
children.translated_text: If he releases [the cow instead]: 'Mother of the <s>Rudras</s>, daughter of the <s>Vasus</s>, sister of the <s>Ādityas</s>, the navel of immortality —

children.text: pra nu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa // VGrs_11.23
children.translated_text: I declare to the discerning person: do not kill the guileless cow <s>Aditi</s>.' // <s>VGrs</s> 11.23

children.text: om utsṛjata tṛṇānyat tūdakaṃ pibatu // VGrs_11.24
children.translated_text: '<s>Oṃ</s>, release her. Let her eat grass and drink water.' // <s>VGrs</s> 11.24
When this is said, they [ceremonially] touch the animal. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.25

children.text: śaṃ no mitra iti pāṇī prakṣālya yathārtham // VGrs_11.26
children.translated_text: Having washed his hands with [the verse] '<s>Śaṃ no Mitraḥ</s>' (May <s>Mitra</s> be auspicious to us), [he proceeds] as appropriate. // <s>VGrs</s> 11.26

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, 11

children.text: athālaṃkaraṇam alaṃkaraṇam asi sarvasmā alaṃ bhūyāsam // VGrs_12.1
children.translated_text: Now the self-adornment (<s>alaṃkaraṇa</s>): 'You are adornment; may I be adequate for all.' // <s>VGrs</s> 12.1

children.text: prāṇāpānau me tarpayāmi samānavyānau me tarpayāmy udānarūpe me tarpayāmi cakṣuḥśrotre me tarpayāmi sucakṣā aham akṣibhyāṃ bhūyāsaṃ suvarcā mukhena suśrutkarṇābhyām iti gandhācchādane // VGrs_12.2
children.translated_text: 'I satisfy my <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s>; I satisfy my <s>samāna</s> and <s>vyāna</s>; I satisfy my <s>udāna</s> and form; I satisfy my sight and hearing. May I be of good sight with my eyes, of good splendor with my face, of good hearing with my ears' — [this is said] with [applying] fragrance and garments. // <s>VGrs</s> 12.2

children.text: paridhāsye yaśo dhāsye dīrghāyutvāya jaradaṣṭir asmi /
children.translated_text: 'I shall put on; I shall bestow glory; for long life — I am one who reaches old age.

children.text: śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīrvasūni cāyyo vibhajāya jīyām /
children.translated_text: Live a hundred autumns, full and many; and may I live distributing wealth to those worthy of it.'

children.text: ityahataṃ vāsa ācchādyāgniṃ prajvālya vyāhṛtibhir vrīhiyavān hutvā maṅgalāny āśāset // VGrs_12.3
children.translated_text: Having covered oneself with a fresh garment, kindling the fire, offering rice and barley with the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances), he should wish for auspicious things. // <s>VGrs</s> 12.3

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, Chapter 12.

children.text: atha pravadane kanyāmupavasitāṃ snātāṃ saśiraskām ahatenācchinnadaśena vāsasā saṃvītāṃ saṃstīrṇasya purastād vihitāni vāditrāṇi vidhivadupakalpya purastāt sviṣṭakṛto vāce pathyāyai pūṣṇe pṛthivyā agnaye senāyai dhenāyai gāyatryai triṣṭubhe jagatyā anuṣṭubhe paṅktaye virāje rākāyai sinīvālyai kuhvai tvaṣṭra āśāyai sampattyai bhūtyai nirṛtyā anumatyai parjanyāyāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte ca juhuyāt // VGrs_13.1
children.translated_text: Now, regarding the playing of instruments (<s>pravadana</s>): having prepared the maiden who has fasted and bathed, wearing a head-covering and wrapped in a fresh garment with an uncut border, and having properly arranged the prescribed instruments before the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> [offering], he should make offerings to <s>Vāc</s> (speech), <s>Pathyā</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s> (earth), <s>Agni</s>, <s>Senā</s>, <s>Dhenā</s>, <s>Gāyatrī</s>, <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, <s>Jagatī</s>, <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, <s>Paṅkti</s>, <s>Virāj</s>, <s>Rākā</s>, <s>Sinīvālī</s>, <s>Kuhū</s>, <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Āśā</s> (hope), <s>Sampatti</s> (success), <s>Bhūti</s> (prosperity), <s>Nirṛti</s>, <s>Anumati</s>, <s>Parjanya</s>, and <s>Agni Sviṣṭakṛt</s>. // <s>VGrs</s> 13.1

children.text: ājyaśeṣeṇa pāṇī pralipya kanyāyā mukhaṃ saṃmārṣṭi priyāṃ karomi pataye devarāṇāṃ śvaśurāya ca /
children.translated_text: Having anointed his palms with the remainder of the clarified butter, he wipes the maiden's face [saying]: 'I make her pleasing to [her] husband, to the king of gods, and to [her] father-in-law.

children.text: rucyai tvāgniḥ saṃsṛjatu ruciṣyā pataye bhava /
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> unite you with charm; be charming to [your] husband.

children.text: saubhāgyena tvā saṃsṛjatv ilā devī ghṛtapadīndrāṇy agnāyyaśvinī rāṭ /
children.translated_text: May the goddess <s>Ilā</s> unite you with good fortune — she of butter-rich paths, <s>Indrāṇī</s>, <s>Agnāyī</s>, <s>Aśvinī</s>, the sovereign,
<s>Vāk</s>, <s>Ilā</s>, <s>Dyaus</s>, <s>Arundhatī</s>.'
And thus. // <s>VGrs</s> 13.2

children.text: sarvāṇi vāditrāṇy abhimantrayate yā caturdhā pravadaty agnau yā vāte yā bṛhatyuta /
children.translated_text: He consecrates all the instruments [with the verse]: 'She who speaks in four ways — in the fire, in the wind, in the <s>Bṛhatī</s> [meter],

children.text: paśūnāṃ yāṃ brāhmaṇe nyadadhuḥ śivā sā pravadatv iha /
children.translated_text: she whom they placed among the animals and in the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> — may that auspicious one speak here.'
Thus. // <s>VGrs</s> 13.3

children.text: sarvāṇi vāditrāṇy alaṃkṛtya kanyā pravādayate śubhaṃ vada dundubhe suprajāstvāya gomukha /
children.translated_text: Having adorned all the instruments, the maiden plays [them] [with the verse]: 'Speak auspiciously, O drum; may there be good offspring, O bull-faced one.

children.text: prakrīḍantu kanyāḥ sumanasyamānāḥ sahendrāṇyā savayasaḥ sanīḍāḥ /
children.translated_text: Let the maidens play about with joyful minds, with their companions of equal age, with those of the same nest, together with <s>Indrāṇī</s>.

children.text: prajāpatiryo vasati prajāsu prajās tanvate sumanasyamānāḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> who dwells among progeny — the people multiply with joyful minds.

children.text: sa imāḥ prajā ramayatu prajātyai svayaṃ ca no ramatāṃ śaṃ dadhānaḥ /
children.translated_text: May he delight these people for the sake of offspring, and may he himself delight us, bestowing happiness.'
Thus. // <s>VGrs</s> 13.4
They play the <s>kārālika</s> instruments. // <s>VGrs</s> 13.5
He should sprinkle the maiden with water. // <s>VGrs</s> 13.6

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, Chapter 13.

children.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, Chapter 14.

children.text: khe rathasya khe 'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakratoḥ /
children.translated_text: 'In the nave of the chariot, in the nave of the cart, in the nave of the yoke, O <s>Śatakratu</s> (<s>Indra</s>),
<s>Indra</s> made the young woman not barren, thrice fulfilled, of sun-like splendor.'
Then he gives her a fresh garment. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.1

children.text: athaināṃ darbhaśulvena saṃnahyati saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ saṃ tvā nahyāmy adbhiroṣadhībhiḥ /
children.translated_text: Then he girds her with a cord of <s>darbha</s> grass [saying]: 'I gird you with the milk of the earth; I gird you with waters and herbs;

children.text: saṃ tvā nahyāmi prajayā dhanena saha saṃnaddhā sunuhi bhāgadheyam /
children.translated_text: I gird you with offspring and wealth — being girded, pour forth [your] share of fortune.'
Thus. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.2

children.text: athaināṃ vāsaso 'ntaṃ grāhayitvābhyudānayati aghoracakṣur apatighny edhi /
children.translated_text: Then, having her hold the hem of [his] garment, he leads her forth [saying]: 'Be of gentle gaze, not deadly to [your] husband;
come, be auspicious to the cattle, of joyful mind, of good splendor;

children.text: dīrghāyupatnī prajayā svarvid indrapraṇayīr upa no vastum ehi /
children.translated_text: long-lived wife, knowing heaven through offspring, led by <s>Indra</s>, come to dwell with us.'
Thus. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.3

body.text: samūhanollepanoddhananāvekṣaṇam ity agnikāle bhūmisaṃskārān sarvatra yathānimittam // VGrs_14.4
body.translated_text: Sweeping, smearing, sprinkling, and inspection — these are the preparations of the ground at the time of the fire-rite, everywhere as occasion requires. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.4

body.text: paścādagneḥ kaṭe tejanyāṃ vā darbheṣv āsanam // VGrs_14.5
body.translated_text: The seat is on <s>darbha</s> grass, west of the fire, on a mat or on the <s>tejanī</s> [layer]. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.5

children.text: śucau bhūmipradeśe śamīśamakaśyāmākānāṃ priyaṅgudūrvāgaurasarṣapāṇāṃ yathālābhagandhasakṣīraphalavadbhyo vanaspatibhyo haritparṇakuśayavādibhiś cānnair yā oṣadhayaḥ /
children.translated_text: On a clean spot of ground, with <s>śamī</s>, <s>śamaka</s>, <s>śyāmāka</s> (millet), <s>priyaṅgu</s> (foxtail millet), <s>dūrvā</s> (bent grass), white mustard, whatever fragrant and juicy fruit-bearing trees are available, and with green leaves, <s>kuśa</s> grass, barley, and other food-grains — the herbs that

children.text: samanyā yantīty anuvākena śaṃ no devīriti ca sahiraṇyāpo 'bhimantrya praṇītodakumbhaṃ praṇayet // VGrs_14.6
children.translated_text: 'come together' — having consecrated the water with gold by the section beginning '<s>Samanyā yanti</s>' and '<s>Śaṃ no devīḥ</s>' (May the divine [waters] be auspicious to us), he should bring forth the consecrated water-vessel. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.6

body.text: taṃ lājāhutīṣu hūyamānāsu bhrātā brahmacārī vodgṛhya dhārayed dakṣiṇataśca // VGrs_14.7
body.translated_text: That [vessel], during the oblations of parched grain (<s>lāja</s>), a brother or a <s>brahmacārin</s>, having taken it up, should hold it from the south side. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.7

body.text: lājān saṃskṛtān śamīparṇamiśrān śūrpeṇa dakṣiṇato mātānyā vāvidhavā // VGrs_14.8
body.translated_text: The consecrated parched grains, mixed with <s>śamī</s> leaves, are [held] in a winnowing basket from the south by the mother or another non-widowed woman. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.8

body.text: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā // VGrs_14.9
body.translated_text: Having consecrated the clarified butter, having addressed the <s>Brahman</s> [priest], having placed a fuel-stick, and having made the two <s>āghāra</s> (preliminary pourings) and having offered the two <s>ājyabhāga</s> (butter-portions) — // <s>VGrs</s> 14.9

body.text:
atha juhoti /
agnaye janavide svāhā /
somāya janavide svāhā /
gandharvāya janavide svāhā /
somaḥ prathamo vivide gandharvo vivida uttaraḥ /
tṛtīyo 'gniṣṭe patisturyo 'haṃ manuṣyajāḥ /

children.translated_text: <s>Svāhā</s>!
<s>Soma</s> gave [her] to <s>Gandharva</s>, <s>Gandharva</s> gave [her] to <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: rayiṃ ca putrāṃś cādād agnir mahyamatho imām /
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> gave to me wealth and sons, and also this [bride].'
Thus. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.10

children.text: hiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭābhiḥ pratyṛcam ājyāhutīr juhuyāt // VGrs_14.11
children.translated_text: With the eight [verses beginning with] '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s>' (Golden Embryo), he should offer oblations of clarified butter at each verse. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.11
