children.text:
yena karmaṇertset tatra jayāñ juhuyāditi jayānāṃ śrutiḥ /
tvā yathoktam /
ākūtyai tvā svāhā /
bhūtyai tvā svāhā /
kāmāyai tvā svāhā /
rakṣāyai tvā svāhā /
samṛdhe tvā svāhā /
samṛddhyai tvā svāhā /
children.translated_text: Wherever one would perform a ritual action, there one should offer the <s>Jaya</s> oblations — this is the scriptural teaching of the <s>Jaya</s> [oblations]. 'You' as prescribed. '<s>Svāhā</s> to you for resolve (<s>ākūti</s>)! <s>Svāhā</s> to you for prosperity (<s>bhūti</s>)! <s>Svāhā</s> to you for desire (<s>kāma</s>)! <s>Svāhā</s> to you for protection (<s>rakṣā</s>)! <s>Svāhā</s> to you for success (<s>samṛddhi</s>)! <s>Svāhā</s> to you for accomplishment (<s>samṛddhi</s>)!'
With a <s>ṛc</s> (verse) the <s>stoma</s> (hymn of praise);
to <s>Prajāpati</s>;
'<s>Bhūḥ svāhā</s>!'
And '<s>Ayāś cāgne</s>' (And you, O <s>Agni</s>). // <s>VGrs</s> 14.12

children.text:
uttarato 'gner darbheṣu prācīṃ kanyām avasthāpya purastāt pratyaṅmukha upayantā devasya te savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāmy aham asāv ity athāsyā upanayanavaddhastaṃ gṛhṇāti nīcāriktam ariktena /
gṛhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastaṃ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭir yathāsat /
bhago 'ryamā savitā puraṃdhir mahyaṃ tvādurgāharpatyāya devāḥ /
ūrdhvā vāk samabhavat purā devāsurebhyaḥ /
yāṃ tvā viśvasya bhūtasya prāg āyāmy asyā agrataḥ /
sarasvati predam ava subhage vājinīvati /
yena bhūtaṃ samabhavad yena viśvamidaṃ jagat tāmadya gāthāṃ gāsyāmo yā strīṇām uttamaṃ manaḥ /
sā tvam asy amo 'ham amo 'hamasmi sā tvam /
dyaur ahaṃ pṛthivī tvaṃ bṛhad ahaṃ rathaṃtaraṃ tvam /
reto 'ham asmi retodhṛk tvam /
sāmāham asmi ṛktvaṃ mano 'hamasmi vāktvam /
children.translated_text: Having stationed the maiden on <s>darbha</s> grass north of the fire, facing east, the bridegroom, facing west, from the front, grasps [her] hand [saying]: 'At the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, with the arms of the <s>Aśvins</s>, with the hands of <s>Pūṣan</s>, I grasp your hand, I, so-and-so.' Then he grasps her hand as in the <s>upanayana</s> (initiation), the lower [hand] by the one not yet emptied [of water]. 'I grasp your hand for the sake of good fortune; may you grow old with me as your husband. <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, <s>Puraṃdhi</s> — the gods have given you to me for householdership. The upward-rising speech came into being before the gods and <s>Asuras</s>. That [speech] which I summon here before all beings, before her — O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, favor this [bride], O fair one, O giver of prizes. By which all that exists came into being, by which this entire universe [was made] — that song we shall now sing, which is the supreme mind of women. You are she, I am he; I am he, you are she. The sky am I, the earth are you; the <s>Bṛhat</s> [<s>Sāman</s>] am I, the <s>Rathantara</s> are you. The seed am I, the seed-bearer are you. The <s>Sāman</s> am I, the <s>Ṛc</s> are you; the mind am I, speech are you.

children.text: sā mām anuvratā bhava sā mām anuprajāyasva /
children.translated_text: Be devoted to me; follow me in offspring.

children.text: prajāṃ sṛjāvahā ubhau puṃse putrāya kartave /
children.translated_text: Let us two together create offspring, for the sake of a man, for the sake of a son.
For glory, for a son, for the sake of knowledge, here, O truthful one.'
Thus. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.13
He should lead [her] around the fire clockwise. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.14

children.text: paścād agner darbheṣvaśmānamavasthāpayati ātiṣṭhemam aśmānamaśmeva tvaṃ sthirā bhava /
children.translated_text: West of the fire, on <s>darbha</s> grass, he places a stone [saying]: 'Step upon this stone; be firm like a stone.

children.text: kṛṇvantu viśve devā āyuṣṭe śaradaḥ śatam /
children.translated_text: May all the gods make your life a hundred autumns.'
Thus. // <s>VGrs</s> 14.15
Right there he gives her the second garment.

children.text: uparyagnāv añjalau lājān bhrātā brahmacārī vopastīrṇa āvapet // VGrs_14.17
children.translated_text: Over the fire, a brother or a celibate student, with [his palms] spread open, pours parched grains (<s>lāja</s>) into her joined palms.

children.text:
tān abhighāritān avicchindatī juhuyāt /
kartānumantrayeta /
iyaṃ nāry upabrūte lājān āvapantikā /
dīrghāyurastu me patir edhantāṃ jñātayo mama /
children.translated_text: Those [grains], having been anointed with ghee, she offers without breaking them. The officiant recites: 'This woman, pouring the parched grains, declares: May my husband live long; may my kinsmen prosper!'
'The maiden worshipped the divine <s>Aryaman</s> through the fire;
may that god <s>Aryaman</s>, being propitiated, release us from here.'
<s>Svāhā</s>!
Thus.

children.text: vīrasūr jīvapatnīr bhūyāsam iti sarvatra vācayet // VGrs_14.19
children.translated_text: 'May I be a mother of heroes, with a living husband' — he should have her recite in every [round].
'For you first I led around <s>Sūryā</s> together with the wedding procession;

children.text: punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha /
children.translated_text: give back the wife to her husbands, O <s>Agni</s>, together with offspring.'
Thus he leads her around a second time.
The third [circumambulation] is done in the same way.
From the stopping-point onward, it is the same [procedure].
'The divine <s>Pūṣan</s>...'
'The divine <s>Varuṇa</s>...' — these are the oblations.
'The maiden worshipped through the fire' — this is the same [as before].

children.text: kāmena caturthī pūrayitvā dvir abhighāryottarārdhapūrvārdhe juhuyāt // VGrs_14.22
children.translated_text: Optionally, having completed a fourth [round] and having anointed twice, he should offer [oblations] in the northern and eastern halves [of the fire].

children.text:
athaināṃ prācīṃ sapta padāni prakramayati ekam iṣe viṣṇustvāṃ nayatu /
dve ūrje /
trīṇi rāyaspoṣāya /
catvāri māyobhavāya /
pañca prajābhyaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then he makes her step forward seven steps toward the east: 'One [step] for food — may <s>Viṣṇu</s> lead you; two for vigor; three for the increase of wealth; four for well-being; five for offspring;
six for the seasons;
seven for the seven oblations.'
'May <s>Viṣṇu</s> lead you' — he should add this from the second [step] onward.

children.text: sakhī saptapadī bhava sakhyaṃ te gameyaṃ sakhyātte mā riṣam iti saptama enāṃ prekṣamāṇāṃ samīkṣate // VGrs_14.23
children.translated_text: 'Having taken seven steps, become a friend; may I attain your friendship; may I not be separated from your friendship' — at the seventh [step] he looks at her as she gazes [at him].

children.text: pra tvā muñcātu varuṇasya pāśād yena tvābadhnāt savitā suśevaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'May <s>Varuṇa</s> release you from the bond with which the benevolent <s>Savitṛ</s> has bound you;

children.text: dhātuśca yonau sukṛtasya loke hṛṣṭā saṃ saha patyā bhūyāsam /
children.translated_text: in the womb of <s>Dhātṛ</s>, in the world of merit, may you be joyful together with your husband.'

children.text: iti śulvaṃ visraṃsyodakumbhena mārjayante punantu mā pitara ityanuvākena /
children.translated_text: With these [mantras], having loosened the cord, they purify [her] with a water jar, [reciting] the <s>anuvāka</s> 'May the Fathers purify me.'
With the [hymn] beginning with '<s>āpo hi ṣṭhā</s>' — say some.

children.text: sumaṅgalīr iyaṃ vadhur imāṃ sametya paśyata /
children.translated_text: 'This bride is auspicious; come and behold her;
having given her good fortune, depart as is proper.'
Thus.
The remainder [of the ceremony] is explained by [the procedure of] the <s>sthālīpāka</s> (boiled rice offering).
'O <s>Agni</s>, lead [us] along the good path for [the enjoyment of] wealth; O God, you who know all the ways.

children.text: yena dyaur ugrety evaṃprabhṛtaya udvāhe homāḥ syuḥ /
children.translated_text: Remove from us crooked sin; we shall offer you the greatest reverent praise.'
With these two [verses] he rises.
Whoever [officiant] leads [the bride] to the groom's house with a cart, or a chariot, or a carriage,

body.translated_text: Then he offers: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s> the knower of beings! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Soma</s> the knower of beings! <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Gandharva</s> the knower of beings! <s>Soma</s> first obtained [her], <s>Gandharva</s> obtained [her] next; <s>Agni</s> was your third husband, and I, born of men, am the fourth.

children.translated_text: he is [to be honored] in the wedding; or [it is done] by the father, brother, or anyone of the same <s>gotra</s>.

children.text: aṅkau nyaṅkāv abhito rathaṃ ye dhvāntā vātā agram abhi ye saṃpatanti /
children.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, [Chapter] 15.

children.text: dūrehetiḥ patatrī vājinīvāṃs te no 'gnayaḥ paprayaḥ pārayantu /
children.translated_text: When they set out: 'May <s>Pūṣan</s> lead you by the hand from here.'
'<s>Āśvinau</s> (the divine twins), carry you in a chariot.'

children.text: sukiṃśukaṃ śalmaliṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ sudhuraṃ sucakram /
children.translated_text: 'Go to the house, be the mistress of the house.'

children.text: āroha sūrye amṛtasya panthāṃs tena yāhi gṛhān svasti /
children.translated_text: 'Be sovereign over your husband's father, be sovereign over your husband's mother;
be sovereign over your husband's sister, be sovereign over your husband's brother.'

children.text: upa māyantu devatā upa brahma suvīryam /
children.translated_text: With these [mantras] they proceed.

children.text: upa kṣatraṃ ca yadbalamupa māmaitu yadbalam /
children.translated_text: When [the bride] sees the house: 'May there be no hatred in your gaze, be not a husband-slayer;
be gentle to the cattle, auspicious, radiant; be a mother of heroes, loving the gods.'

children.text: anu māyantu devatā anu brahma suvīryam /
children.translated_text: A <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> woman should recite: 'May your entrance be auspicious.'

children.text: anu kṣatraṃ ca yad yaśamanu māmaitu yadyaśam /
children.translated_text: He should have [the bride] enter and sit upon a red bull-hide [placed] with [its neck] facing east, [saying:]

children.text: iti prāñcaṃ prayāpya pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya yathārthalakṣaṇyavṛkṣaṃ caityaṃ vopatiṣṭheta // VGrs_15.4
children.translated_text: 'May the <s>Viśvedevas</s> (all-gods) and the waters unite your hearts!'
He looks at her: 'Auspicious are your eyes; do not look at me with evil eye;

children.text: ye vṛkṣeṣu śaṣpiñjarā iti ca // VGrs_15.5
children.translated_text: be benevolent to the cattle; radiant, gentle — be a mother of heroes.'
The <s>sthālīpāka</s> procedure and the rest are as stated previously.

children.text: ye pathāṃ pathirakṣaya iti ca // VGrs_15.6
children.translated_text: '<s>Saṃrāj</s> (sovereign)' — with this [mantra] they eat the meal.
When [the bride] is to go to the bed: 'May <s>Viśvāvasu</s> depart from here.'

children.text: ye bhūtānām adhipataya iti ca // VGrs_15.7
children.translated_text: 'We worship <s>Viśvāvasu</s> [the <s>Gandharva</s>].'
'Rise up from here, <s>Viśvāvasu</s>; we worship you with reverence.'
'Seek another young girl, ready and willing; go to her dwelling, [leave] the wife with her husband.'

body.translated_text: 'I am he, you are she; you are she, I am he; I am the <s>Sāman</s> (melody), you are the <s>Ṛc</s> (verse); I am heaven, you are earth. Come, let us unite together; let us deposit seed, that we may obtain a son.'

children.text: yatrāpas taritavyā āsīd ati samudrāya vayunāya sindhūnāṃ pataye namaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'A boy shall be born.'
They sit silently until the stars appear.
When the stars appear, having gone out, to the south he shows her the pole star: 'You are firm; I see you, the firm one. Be firm in me, O radiant one!
<s>Bṛhaspati</s> has given you to me; obtaining offspring through me your husband, live with me a hundred autumns.'

children.text: yāvatāṃ sakhāyānaṃ svastimicchet tāvata udakāñjalīr juhuyāt amṛtam āsye juhomyāyuḥ prāṇe pratidadhāmi amṛtaṃ brahmaṇā saha mṛtyuṃ tarema /
children.translated_text: She shows him the star <s>Arundhatī</s>.

children.text: prāsahād itīṣṭir asyaditir eva mṛtyuṃdhayamiti trir ācāmet // VGrs_15.11
children.translated_text: [He says to her:] 'You are not firm!'

body.translated_text: For three nights they observe celibacy, sleeping on the ground.

body.text: yadyakṣā śamyāṇir vā riṣyeta tatraivāgnim upasamādhāyāgneyena sthālīpākeneṣṭvā jayaprabhṛtibhiś cājyasya pustāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ // VGrs_15.13
body.translated_text: They abstain from salted and pungent food.
At the end of the third night, or on the morning of the fourth day, the <s>sthālīpāka</s> procedure and the rest are as stated previously.
He offers oblations in the fire: 'To <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Soma</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!'
And with the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s>.

children.translated_text: The conclusion of the rite is as stated previously.

children.text: irāṃ vahantī ghṛtam ukṣamāṇāṃs teṣv ahaṃ sumanāḥ saṃviśāmi /
children.translated_text: 'Then, approaching her, he says: "<s>Amā</s>" (at home).'
'<s>Vāmadevya</s>.'
'<s>Bṛhatsāman</s> (the great melody).'

body.translated_text: Thus [he recites these <s>Sāmans</s> at the conclusion].

body.text: athāsyā brahmacāriṇaṃ jīvapitṛkaṃ jīvamātṛkam utsaṅgamupaveśayet // VGrs_15.19
body.translated_text: On the fourth day, the rites of [going to] the four directions.
He goes to the east: 'May the eastern direction consent to me!' — thus invoking the directions, he enters.

body.text: acyutā dhruvā dhruvapatnī dhruvaṃ paśyema viśvata iti dhruvaṃ jīvantīṃ saptarṣīn arundhatīmiti darśayitvā prājāpatyena sthālīpākeneṣṭvā jayaprabhṛtibhiś cājyasya purastāt sviṣṭakṛta ājyaśeṣe dadhyāsicya dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam iti dadhnaḥ pumāṃstriḥ prāśnāti // VGrs_15.21
body.translated_text: To the south, west, north — likewise.

children.text: cakram ivānaḍuhaḥ padaṃ māmevānvetu te manaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, the <s>anvārambhaṇīya</s> (commencement) oblation: he initiates the ritual with all mantras as stated previously. [He offers] the <s>sthālīpāka</s>.

children.text: māṃ ca paśyasi sūryaṃ ca mā cānyeṣu manaskṛthāḥ /
children.translated_text: '<s>Namo Rudrāya</s> (Homage to <s>Rudra</s>)' — with this he offers the <s>bali</s> (offering share) [placing it] on all four sides.

children.text: cākravākaṃ saṃvasanaṃ tan nau saṃvananaṃ kṛtam /
children.translated_text: Then the <s>śūlagava</s> (ox-on-a-spit) offering: 'O <s>Rudra</s>, do not harm our great [ones], our small [ones], our growing [ones], our full-grown [ones];
do not harm our father, nor our mother; do not harm our own dear bodies.'

body.translated_text: 'Do not harm our children, our grandchildren, our people; do not harm our cattle, our horses.'

children.translated_text: 'O <s>Rudra</s>, do not slay — for we call upon you always with oblations! [Homage] to you!'
'<s>Bhava</s> and <s>Śarva</s>! Do not harm us!'

body.text: evameva caturthyāṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭābhiḥ sthālīpākasya hutvā jayaprabhṛtibhiścājyasya purastātsviṣṭakṛtaḥ // VGrs_15.25
body.translated_text: With these [mantras] he puts a strong ox on a spit [and offers it].

body.text: athāsyāḥ savye 'ṃse pūṣā te granthiṃ grathnātv iti vāsaso granthiṃ kriyamāṇam anumantrayate // VGrs_15.26
body.translated_text: 'The strong ox on the spit — for <s>Rudra</s>, I offer this; may he not harm us!'

children.translated_text: He makes the <s>bali</s> offering with the <s>caruṣṭhālīpāka</s> in the fire; the remainder is as stated previously.
<s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, [Chapter] 16.
After union, [the husband says]: 'O <s>Viṣṇu</s>, prepare the womb! O <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, fashion the forms! O <s>Prajāpati</s>, pour in!
O <s>Dhātṛ</s>, place the embryo!'

body.text:
Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 16
tau saṃnipātayataḥ /
apaśyaṃ tvā manasā cekitānaṃ tapaso jātaṃ tapaso 'bhibhūtam /
iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇaḥ prajāyasva prajayā putrakāma /
apaśyaṃ tvā manasā dīdhyānāṃ svāyāṃ tanūm ṛtviye nādhamānām /
upa mām uccā yuvatir babhūyāt prajāyasva prajayā putrakāme /
prajāpate tanvaṃ me juṣasva tvaṣṭā vīraiḥ sahasāham indraḥ /

children.text: indreṇa devairvīrudhaḥ saṃvyayantāṃ bahūnāṃ puṃsāṃ pitarau syāva /
children.translated_text: may the herbs unite with [the blessing of] <s>Indra</s> and the gods. May we two be parents of many sons!'

children.text: ahaṃ prajā ajanayaṃ pṛthivyām ahaṃ garbham adadhāmoṣadhīṣu /
children.translated_text: 'I have generated offspring on the earth; I have placed the embryo in the herbs;

children.text: ahaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvantar ahaṃ prajābhyo bibharṣi putrān /
children.translated_text: I [am present] within all the worlds; I sustain sons for the offspring.'
Thus he recites, transposing the first-person/third-person [forms].
'<s>Karat</s>' (may he do) — he touches the buttocks [of the wife].
'<s>Janat</s>' (may he beget) — [he touches] above the generative organ.
'<s>Bṛhat</s>' (may [the child be] great) — when [the child] is born, it is established.

children.text: athāsyāstṛtīye garbhamāse puṃsā nakṣatreṇa yad ahaścandramā na dṛśyeta tadahar vopoṣyāplāvyāhataṃ vāsa ācchādya nyagrodhāvarohaśuṅgānyudapeṣaṃ piṣṭvā dakṣiṇāsminnāsikāchidra āsiñcet hiraṇyagarbhaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, in the third month of her pregnancy, on a male <s>nakṣatra</s>, on the day when the moon is not visible, having fasted and bathed and covered [her] with an unworn garment, he pounds shoots of aerial roots of a banyan tree with water, and pours [the paste] into her right nostril [with the mantras]: '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s>' [and]
'Who was born from the waters' — with these two [mantras].

children.text: athāsyā dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣim abhimṛśet pumān agniḥ pumānindraḥ pumāndevo bṛhaspatiḥ /
children.translated_text: Then he touches her right flank: 'Male is <s>Agni</s>, male is <s>Indra</s>, male is the god <s>Bṛhaspati</s>;
male are <s>Agni</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>; male is the embryo in your womb.
Male are <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; male are both <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: pumāṃsaṃ garbhaṃ jāyasva tvaṃ pumān anujāyatām /
children.translated_text: Bear a male embryo; may a male be born after you!'
With these two [mantras].

children.text: athāsyāḥ pañcame ṣaṣṭhe saptame vā garbhamāse maṅgalyaiḥ snāpayitvā prājāpatyena sthālīpākeneṣṭvā jayaprabhṛtibhiścājyasya purastātsviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, in the fifth, sixth, or seventh month of her pregnancy, having bathed [her] with auspicious [substances], having offered the <s>sthālīpāka</s> to <s>Prajāpati</s>, and with oblations of ghee beginning with the <s>jaya</s> [mantras] before the offering to <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s>,

children.text: paścādagnerdarbheṣv āsīnāyāḥ sarvān keśān vipramucya tvamaryamā bhavasi yatkanīnāṃ devaḥ svadhāvo guhyaṃ bibharṣi /
children.translated_text: To her who is seated on <s>darbha</s> grass behind the fire, having loosened all her hair, [he recites:] 'You are <s>Aryaman</s>, insofar as you are the god of maidens; O god, self-ruler, you bear the secret.'

children.text: añjanti vipraṃ sukṛtaṃ na gobhir yad dampatī sumanasā kṛṇoṣi /
children.translated_text: 'They anoint the wise one, well-made, as if with cows; for you make the couple well-minded.'

children.text: iti navanītena pāṇī pralipya sarvān keśān saṃprayauti // VGrs_16.7
children.translated_text: Thus, having smeared both hands with fresh butter, he gathers all the hair together. // <s>VGrs</s> 16.7

children.text: indrāṇī cakre kaṅkataṃ sa sīmantaṃ visarpatu iti kaṅkataṃ gṛhṇāti // VGrs_16.8
children.translated_text: '<s>Indrāṇī</s> made the comb; let it spread along the parting' — thus he takes the comb. // <s>VGrs</s> 16.8
Again, with [the mantra] '<s>Agni</s> is the wife,' he should perform the hair-arranging. // <s>VGrs</s> 16.9
With a porcupine quill, with a branch of <s>śamī</s> (Prosopis cineraria) that still has its leaves,
'[May you who are] pregnant [bear] a male child, long-living, of a hundred years' lifespan;'

children.text: dīrghāyur asyā yaḥ patir jīvātu śaradaḥ śatam /
children.translated_text: 'May her husband be long-lived; may he live a hundred autumns.'
Thus, with three white [instruments], he makes the hair-parting. // <s>VGrs</s> 16.10

children.text: athāsyāḥ patir dvedhā keśān badhnāti nīlalohitena sūtreṇa jīvorṇayā vā // VGrs_16.11
children.translated_text: Then her husband ties the hair in two parts with a blue-red thread, or with living wool. // <s>VGrs</s> 16.11

body.translated_text: 'O <s>Sinīvālī</s>, place the embryo; O <s>Sinīvālī</s>, of wide braids, of wide form, place the embryo;

children.translated_text: Now we shall explain the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> (offering to all gods). // <s>VGrs</s> 17.1

children.text: tatra sāyaṃprātaḥprabhṛtīnām agnihotravat parisamuhya paristīrya paryukṣya sāyaṃ prātaḥ syādityeke // VGrs_17.2
children.translated_text: There, for the evening and morning [offerings] and those that follow, having swept around, strewn [sacred grass], and sprinkled around, as in the <s>Agnihotra</s> — it should be [performed] evening and morning, say some. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.2
The <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> may be [performed] with sacrificial food or with cooked food. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.3

children.text: agnaye somāya prajāpataye dhanvantaraye vāstoṣpataye viśvebhyo devebhyo 'gnaye sviṣṭakṛte ca juhuyāt // VGrs_17.4
children.translated_text: He should offer oblations to <s>Agni</s>, to <s>Soma</s>, to <s>Prajāpati</s>, to <s>Dhanvantari</s>, to <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, to the <s>Viśvedevas</s> (all-gods), and to <s>Agni Sviṣṭakṛt</s>. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.4
He should make <s>bali</s>-offerings with the remainder. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.5

children.text: dadhimadhumiśrasyāgnaye purastāt yamāya dakṣiṇataḥ somāya paścāt varuṇāyottarataḥ madhye varuṇāryamabhyāṃ brahmaṇe ca /
children.translated_text: [With food] mixed with curds and honey: to <s>Agni</s> in the east, to <s>Yama</s> in the south, to <s>Soma</s> in the west, to <s>Varuṇa</s> in the north, in the center to <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Aryaman</s>, and to <s>Brahman</s>;

children.text: agnaye pṛthivyai vāyave 'ntarikṣāya sūryāya dive candramase nakṣatrebhya iti // VGrs_17.6
children.translated_text: to <s>Agni</s>, to <s>Pṛthivī</s> (Earth), to <s>Vāyu</s>, to <s>Antarikṣa</s> (Atmosphere), to <s>Sūrya</s>, to <s>Dyaus</s> (Heaven), to <s>Candramā</s> (Moon), and to the <s>Nakṣatras</s> (constellations). // <s>VGrs</s> 17.6
To the Waters, at the place of the water-pot. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.7
To the herbs and trees, in the middle place. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.8
To <s>Kāma</s> (Desire),
to <s>Gṛhapati</s> (lord of the house) — at the place of the bed. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.9
And to <s>Śrī</s> (Fortune). // <s>VGrs</s> 17.10
To the <s>Rakṣojanas</s> (demon-folk), inside the shelter. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.11
'To <s>Ākāśa</s> (Space)' — with the two pot-shards. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.12
Silently going out, [he makes the offering] on top of the shelter. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.13
<s>Kavya</s> (food for the ancestors) in the eastern [direction]. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.14
To the ancestors, he should add [the word] '<s>svadhā</s>.' // <s>VGrs</s> 17.15
And '<s>namaḥ</s>' at the end. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.16

children.text:
ye brāhmaṇāḥ prācyāṃ diśyarhantu /
ye devā yāni bhūtāni prapadye tāni me svastyayanaṃ kurvantviti /
dakṣiṇasyām /
children.translated_text: 'May the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> who are in the eastern direction be honored. Whatever <s>Devas</s>, whatever beings [are there] — I take refuge [in them]; may they bring me well-being.' [Likewise] in the southern [direction],
in the western [direction],
in the northern [direction],
in the upward [direction],
'May the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>...' — this should be added in all [directions]. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.17

children.text: snehavad amāṃsam annaṃ bhojayitvā viduṣo brāhmaṇān arthasiddhiṃ vācayet // VGrs_17.18
children.translated_text: Having fed learned <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> with food that has fat but no meat, he should have them pronounce the accomplishment of the purpose. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.18

children.text: baliharaṇasyānte yāmāśiṣam icchet tām āśāsīta // VGrs_17.19
children.translated_text: At the end of the <s>bali</s>-offering, whatever blessing he desires, he should pray for it. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.19

children.text: gṛhapatiḥ oṃ akṣayam annam astv ity āha // VGrs_17.20
children.translated_text: The householder says: '<s>Oṃ</s>! May the food be inexhaustible!' // <s>VGrs</s> 17.20

children.text: bhikṣāṃ pradāya sāyaṃ bhojanameva prātar āśet // VGrs_17.21
children.translated_text: Having given alms, the evening meal itself should be eaten in the morning [as well]. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.21
Having been away [from home], he should attend to the household [rites upon return]. // <s>VGrs</s> 17.22

body.translated_text: <s>Vārāhagṛhyasūtra</s>, 17
